properly in the wheel-and-lotus diagram, || 138

2.s:
taiḥ pratiṣṭhāntikaṃ sarvaṃ karṣaṇādyamakārayat |
vaiśākhe śravaṇarkṣe tu saṃkalpyāvabhṛśaṃ purā || 139 ||
2.d:
तैः प्रतिष्ठान्तिकं सर्वं कर्षणाद्यमकारयत् |
वैशाखे श्रवणर्क्षे तु संकल्प्यावभृशं पुरा || 139 ||
2.m:
he had them perform all [rites] up to the installation, beginning with the plowing of the ground,
having previously fixed the concluding bath (avabhṛtha) in the month of Vaiśākha under the asterism of Śravaṇa. || 139

2.s:
navame'hni dhvajārohaṃ vidhinā'kārayadvidhiḥ |
prathame'hani deveśaṃ maṇḍapena vibhāsinā || 140 ||
2.d:
नवमेऽह्नि ध्वजारोहं विधिनाऽकारयद्विधिः |
प्रथमेऽहनि देवेशं मण्डपेन विभासिना || 140 ||
2.m: On the ninth day [prior], Brahmā had the flag hoisted according to rule. / On the first day, [having placed] the Lord of the Gods within a radiant pavilion,

2.s:
vīthīḥ sañcārayāmāsa prātarbhaktānukampayā |
rātrau mṛgendravāhena devasyotsavamācarat || 141 ||
2.d:
वीथीः सञ्चारयामास प्रातर्भक्तानुकम्पया |
रात्रौ मृगेन्द्रवाहेन देवस्योत्सवमाचरत् || 141 ||
2.m: he caused him to process through the streets in the morning out of compassion for the devotees. / At night, he conducted the festival of the God upon the lion vehicle.

2.s:
dvitīye divase prātarhaṃsavāhanamācarat |
rātrau mārtaṇḍabimbena mahotsavamakārayat || 142 ||
2.d:
द्वितीये दिवसे प्रातर्हंसवाहनमाचरत् |
रात्रौ मार्तण्डबिम्बेन महोत्सवमकारयत् || 142 ||
2.m: On the second day in the morning, he conducted the swan vehicle. / At night, he had the great festival conducted with the solar orb.

2.s:
tṛtīye divase prātargaruḍotsavamācarat |
avatārātparaṃ devasyotsave prathame purā || 143 ||
2.d:
तृतीये दिवसे प्रातर्गरुडोत्सवमाचरत् |
अवतारात्परं देवस्योत्सवे प्रथमे पुरा || 143 ||
2.m: On the third day in the morning, he conducted the Garuḍa festival. / Anciently, during the first festival of the God after his descent,

2.s:
devo ramāpatirdivyaṃ vainateyamadhiśritaḥ |
prathamaṃ darśayāmāsa nijamaprākṛtaṃ vapuḥ || 144 ||
2.d:
देवो रमापतिर्दिव्यं वैनतेयमधिश्रितः |
प्रथमं दर्शयामास निजमप्राकृतं वपुः || 144 ||
2.m: the God, Lord of Ramā, mounted upon the divine son of Vinatā, / manifested his own extraordinary, non-material form for the first time.

2.s:
madhye gopuramukhyasya tato garuḍavāhane |
gopurāgrimamadhye tu devasevā viśiṣyate || 145 ||
2.d:
मध्ये गोपुरमुख्यस्य ततो गरुडवाहने |
गोपुराग्रिममध्ये तु देवसेवा विशिष्यते || 145 ||
2.m: Then, on the Garuḍa vehicle in the midst of the main gateway tower (gopura)— / service to the God in the middle of the foremost tower is distinguished as superior—

2.s:
sarvapāpaharī puṇyā muktimārga udīritaḥ |
rātrau hanumatā caiva devadevamacārayat || 146 ||
2.d:
सर्वपापहरी पुण्या मुक्तिमार्ग उदीरितः |
रात्रौ हनुमता चैव देवदेवमचारयत् || 146 ||
2.m: it removes all sins, is holy, and is declared to be the path to liberation. / And at night he caused the God of Gods to process upon Hanumat.

2.s:
caturthe divase prātaḥ śeṣāsanatale hariḥ |
paravyomnīva bhaktānāṃ svaṃ rupaṃ samadarśayat || 147 ||
2.d:
चतुर्थे दिवसे प्रातः शेषासनतले हरिः |
परव्योम्नीव भक्तानां स्वं रुपं समदर्शयत् || 147 ||
2.m: On the fourth day in the morning, seated upon the seat of Śeṣa, Hari / revealed to the devotees his own form as if in the supreme heaven.

2.s:
rātrau candramasaṃ bimbamāsthitasyotsavoṃ'bhavat |
mohinīrūpamāsthāya prātarāndolikāṃ gataḥ || 148 ||
2.d:
रात्रौ चन्द्रमसं बिम्बमास्थितस्योत्सवोंऽभवत् |
मोहिनीरूपमास्थाय प्रातरान्दोलिकां गतः || 148 ||
2.m: At night, there was a festival of him seated on the lunar orb. / In the morning, having assumed the form of Mohinī, he ascended a palanquin.

2.s:
paṃcame'hani deveśo bhaktānsarvānanandayat |
p. 18) rātrau tu yālavāhena devasyotsavamācarat || 149 ||
2.d:
पंचमेऽहनि देवेशो भक्तान्सर्वाननन्दयत् |
प्. 18) रात्रौ तु यालवाहेन देवस्योत्सवमाचरत् || 149 ||
2.m: On the fifth day, the Lord of the Gods delighted all devotees. / At night, he conducted the festival of the God upon the yāli vehicle.

2.s:
ṣaṣṭhe prātaḥ kalpatarau veṇugānotsavo'bhavat |
rātrau gajendramāsthāya divyaṃ rūpamadarśayat || 150 ||
2.d:
षष्ठे प्रातः कल्पतरौ वेणुगानोत्सवोऽभवत् |
रात्रौ गजेन्द्रमास्थाय दिव्यं रूपमदर्शयत् || 150 ||
2.m: On the sixth [day] in the morning, under the wishing-tree, there was the festival of flute-playing. / At night, mounted upon the lord of elephants, he revealed his divine form.

2.s:
saptame syandanaṃ divyamāsthāpyotsavamācarat |
aṣṭame tu jaladroṇīmavagāhya divā hariḥ || 151 ||
2.d:
सप्तमे स्यन्दनं दिव्यमास्थाप्योत्सवमाचरत् |
अष्टमे तु जलद्रोणीमवगाह्य दिवा हरिः || 151 ||
2.m: On the seventh [day], having mounted him upon a divine chariot, he conducted the festival. / But on the eighth, having bathed Hari by day in a trough of water,

2.s:
rātrau turaṅgamāsthāya sarvāllokānapāvayat |
navame śibikāyātrāmāracayya ramāpatiḥ || 152 ||
2.d:
रात्रौ तुरङ्गमास्थाय सर्वाल्लोकानपावयत् |
नवमे शिबिकायात्रामारचय्य रमापतिः || 152 ||
2.m: he mounted him at night upon a horse and purified all the worlds. / On the ninth [day], having arranged a procession by litter, the Lord of Ramā,

2.s:
līlāṃ praṇayakopasya pradarśya kamalāvubhuvoḥ |
anantasarasīvarye'vabhṛthaṃ mahamāsthitaḥ || 153 ||
2.d:
लीलां प्रणयकोपस्य प्रदर्श्य कमलावुभुवोः |
अनन्तसरसीवर्येऽवभृथं महमास्थितः || 153 ||
2.m: having displayed the sportive play of love's anger between Kamalā and Bhū, / undertook the concluding bath festival in the excellent Anantasaras pool.

2.s:
rātrau tu puṇyakoṭyākhye vimāne niṣṭhitaḥ prabhuḥ |
sarvaṃ puraṃ paribhramya sarvāṃllokānapāvayat || 154 ||
2.d:
रात्रौ तु पुण्यकोट्याख्ये विमाने निष्ठितः प्रभुः |
सर्वं पुरं परिभ्रम्य सर्वांल्लोकानपावयत् || 154 ||
2.m: At night, the Lord, seated upon the temple tower named Puṇyakoṭi, / circumambulated the entire city and purified all the worlds.

2.s:
daśame'hani madhyāhne puṣpayāgamaho'bhavat |
rātrau mahāvimānena purayātrā prakalpitā || 155 ||
2.d:
दशमेऽहनि मध्याह्ने पुष्पयागमहोऽभवत् |
रात्रौ महाविमानेन पुरयात्रा प्रकल्पिता || 155 ||
2.m: On the tenth day at midday, there was the festival of the flower-sacrifice. / At night, a procession through the city was arranged with the great temple tower [chariot].

2.s:
sarvāvaraṇaniṣkrāmātparaṃ vihagarāṅdhvajam |
avaropayya vidhivatpūjako bahumānitaḥ || 156 ||
2.d:
सर्वावरणनिष्क्रामात्परं विहगराङ्ध्वजम् |
अवरोपय्य विधिवत्पूजको बहुमानितः || 156 ||
2.m: After departing all enclosures, having lowered the flag of the King of Birds / according to rule, the priest was greatly honored.

2.s:
evaṃ saṃrambhayogena mahotsavamakārayat |
prativatsaramevaivaṃ mahotsavavidhiḥ kṛtaḥ || 157 ||
2.d:
एवं संरम्भयोगेन महोत्सवमकारयत् |
प्रतिवत्सरमेवैवं महोत्सवविधिः कृतः || 157 ||
2.m: Thus with intense zeal he had the great festival conducted. / In this very manner the rite of the great festival was performed every year.

2.s:
pakṣamāsāyanābdādyā utsavāścābhavankramāt |
maharṣī dīkṣitau tau dvāvaupagāyanakauśikau || 158 ||
2.d:
पक्षमासायनाब्दाद्या उत्सवाश्चाभवन्क्रमात् |
महर्षी दीक्षितौ तौ द्वावौपगायनकौशिकौ || 158 ||
2.m: And festivals of the half-month, month, solstice, year, and so on took place in order. / Those two great sages, the initiates Aupagāyana and Kauśika,

2.s:
paryāyeṇaiva deveśamānarcyuturihādarāt |
tadetanmahimaṃ dhāma hastiśailaprathāṃ gatam || 159 ||
2.d:
पर्यायेणैव देवेशमानर्च्युतुरिहादरात् |
तदेतन्महिमं धाम हस्तिशैलप्रथां गतम् || 159 ||
2.m: in turns indeed worshipped the Lord of the Gods here with devotion. / That glorious sacred abode gained renown as Hastiśaila,

2.s:
praṇatārtiharo devo varado yatra pūjyate |
pūjakāstasya tadvaśyā mahātmāno guṇojjvalāḥ || 160 ||
2.d:
प्रणतार्तिहरो देवो वरदो यत्र पूज्यते |
पूजकास्तस्य तद्वश्या महात्मानो गुणोज्ज्वलाः || 160 ||
2.m: where the God Varada, remover of the distress of those bowed [to him], is worshipped. / His worshippers, devoted to him, are magnanimous and radiant with virtues,

2.s:
pāñcarātrikamukhyebhyaḥ sarvebhyo'pyadhikā bhuvi |
evametatsamākhyātaṃ hastiśailasya vaibhavam || 161 ||
2.d:
पाञ्चरात्रिकमुख्येभ्यः सर्वेभ्योऽप्यधिका भुवि |
एवमेतत्समाख्यातं हस्तिशैलस्य वैभवम् || 161 ||
2.m: superior on earth to all the foremost Pāñcarātra followers. / Thus has been recounted this majesty of Hastiśaila,

2.s:
devasya tantrasārasya pūjakasya tu saṃgrahāt |
yathā vai nāradamuneḥ mukhātpūrvaṃ śrutaṃ mayā || 162 ||
2.d:
देवस्य तन्त्रसारस्य पूजकस्य तु संग्रहात् |
यथा वै नारदमुनेः मुखात्पूर्वं श्रुतं मया || 162 ||
2.m: of the God, of the essence of the tantra, and of the priest, in summary, / exactly as was previously heard by me from the mouth of the sage Nārada.

2.s:
tathaiva sarvamākhyātaṃ prasaṅgātprītipūrvakam |
atha prakṛtamevādya tantramāraṃbhyate mayā || 163 ||
2.d:
तथैव सर्वमाख्यातं प्रसङ्गात्प्रीतिपूर्वकम् |
अथ प्रकृतमेवाद्य तन्त्रमारंभ्यते मया || 163 ||
2.m: In that very way, everything has been related in this context with pleasure. / Now the original tantra itself is begun by me today;

2.s: śrūyatāmavadhānena śraddhābhaktimahīyasā)
2.d: श्रूयतामवधानेन श्रद्धाभक्तिमहीयसा)
2.m: let it be heard with attention, with the greatest faith and devotion.

2.s:
iti śrīpāñcarātre jayākhyasahitāyāṃ śāstrarambhaprayojanaṃ nāma
prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 1 ||
2.d:
इति श्रीपाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसहितायां शास्त्ररम्भप्रयोजनं नाम
प्रथमः पटलः || 1 ||
2.m: Thus ends the first chapter, named "The Purpose for Beginning the Scripture," in the Jayākhyasaṃhitā of the venerable Pāñcarātra. || 1

3.s: atha brahmasargākhyānaṃ nāma dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ |
3.d: अथ ब्रह्मसर्गाख्यानं नाम द्वितीयः पटलः |
3.m: Now begins the second chapter, named "The Account of the Creation by Brahmā."

3.s: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ-
3.d: ऋषय ऊचुः-

3.s:
ajñānapaṅkamagnānāṃ tvaṃ gatirno mahāmune |
purā yathoktaṃ vibhunā munerbrahmātmajasya ca || 1 ||
3.d:
अज्ञानपङ्कमग्नानां त्वं गतिर्नो महामुने |
पुरा यथोक्तं विभुना मुनेर्ब्रह्मात्मजस्य च || 1 ||
3.m: "You are the refuge of us who are sunk in the mire of ignorance, O great sage. / What was previously spoken by the All-Pervading One to the sage, the son of Brahmā,

3.s:
tatsarvaṃ vistareṇādya yathāvadvaktumarhasi |
[nārado brahmaṇaḥ putro bhavabandhavimuktaye] || 2 ||
3.d:
तत्सर्वं विस्तरेणाद्य यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि |
[नारदो ब्रह्मणः पुत्रो भवबन्धविमुक्तये] || 2 ||
3.m: all that you ought to tell [us] in detail today, properly, / [namely, to Nārada, Brahmā's son, for release from the bonds of transmigratory existence]."

3.s: śāṇḍilyaḥ-
3.d: शाण्डिल्यः-

3.s:
svamātmānaṃ puraskṛtya sadbhaktāya(nāṃ?)hitāya ca |
pādapadme hareḥ smṛtvā stu(na?)ttvā ca śirasā saha || 3 ||
3.d:
स्वमात्मानं पुरस्कृत्य सद्भक्ताय(नां?)हिताय च |
पादपद्मे हरेः स्मृत्वा स्तु(न?)त्त्वा च शिरसा सह || 3 ||
3.m: Placing his own self in front, and for the benefit of good devotees, / remembering the lotus feet of Hari and bowing with his head,

3.s:
prāñjaliḥ prayato bhūtvā protphullavadanekṣaṇaḥ |
praṇayātpraṇato bhūtvā dvandvopadravaśāntaye || 4 ||
3.d:
प्राञ्जलिः प्रयतो भूत्वा प्रोत्फुल्लवदनेक्षणः |
प्रणयात्प्रणतो भूत्वा द्वन्द्वोपद्रवशान्तये || 4 ||
3.m: with folded hands, purified, his face and eyes blossoming, / having bowed down out of affection, for the pacification of the afflictions of duality,

3.s: upasaṅgamya caraṇāvidaṃ stotramadīraye(dairaya?)t |
3.d: उपसङ्गम्य चरणाविदं स्तोत्रमदीरये(दैरय?)त् |
3.m: having approached his feet, he uttered this hymn of praise.

3.s: [nāradakṛtā bhagavatstutiḥ]
3.d: [नारदकृता भगवत्स्तुतिः]
3.m: [Praise of the Lord Composed by Nārada]

3.s: nāradaḥ-
3.d: नारदः-

3.s: namo'stu parameśāya kāraṇāya parāya ca || 5 ||
3.d: नमोऽस्तु परमेशाय कारणाय पराय च || 5 ||
3.m: "Praise be to the Supreme Lord, to the Cause, and to the Transcendent! || 5

3.s:
sahasraśirase tubhyaṃ sahasracaraṇāya ca |
sahasranayanaśrotra sahasrādbhutavikrama || 6 ||
3.d:
सहस्रशिरसे तुभ्यं सहस्रचरणाय च |
सहस्रनयनश्रोत्र सहस्राद्भुतविक्रम || 6 ||
3.m: To you of a thousand heads and a thousand feet, / O you of a thousand eyes and ears, of a thousand wondrous strides!

3.s:
sahasrasūryavapuṣe sahasrendugabhastaye |
namaḥ paramahaṃsāya parātparatarāya ca || 7 ||
3.d:
सहस्रसूर्यवपुषे सहस्रेन्दुगभस्तये |
नमः परमहंसाय परात्परतराय च || 7 ||
3.m: To the one whose body is a thousand suns, whose rays are a thousand moons, / praise to the supreme swan, and to the one higher than the highest!

3.s:
sattvarūpāya śāntāya namo viśvāyanāya ca |
bhavāya bhavahartre ca sargasya prabhavāya ca || 8 ||
3.d:
सत्त्वरूपाय शान्ताय नमो विश्वायनाय च |
भवाय भवहर्त्रे च सर्गस्य प्रभवाय च || 8 ||
3.m: Praise to the peaceful one whose form is pure being, and the refuge of all; / to existence, to the remover of transmigratory existence, and to the source of creation!

3.s:
namaḥ kanakagarbhāya sarvadehabhṛte namaḥ |
trayītrayamayādyāya namaste paramātmane || 9 ||
3.d:
नमः कनकगर्भाय सर्वदेहभृते नमः |
त्रयीत्रयमयाद्याय नमस्ते परमात्मने || 9 ||
3.m: Praise to the golden womb, praise to the bearer of all bodies! / Praise to you, the Supreme Self, the primordial one consisting of the triple Veda!

3.s:
hṛdambujaguhāvāsaparavyomāntaśāyine |
bhaktiyogavidabhyasagrāhyāya khalu te namaḥ || 10 ||
3.d:
हृदम्बुजगुहावासपरव्योमान्तशायिने |
भक्तियोगविदभ्यसग्राह्याय खलु ते नमः || 10 ||
3.m: To the one dwelling in the cave of the heart-lotus, reclining within the supreme heaven, / to you who are truly grasped through the practice of knowing the yoga of devotion, praise!

3.s:
mīno nimīlitākṣastvaṃ kūrmastvaṃ ca nagodvahaḥ |
tvayā rūpaṃ ca kṛtvā'gryaṃ vidhṛtaṃ bhūmimaṇḍalam || 11 ||
3.d:
मीनो निमीलिताक्षस्त्वं कूर्मस्त्वं च नगोद्वहः |
त्वया रूपं च कृत्वाऽग्र्यं विधृतं भूमिमण्डलम् || 11 ||
3.m: You are the Fish with closed eyes, and you are the Tortoise bearing the mountain; / and having assumed that foremost form [of the Boar], the orb of the earth was held up by you.

3.s:
bhayābhaye tvayaikasyāṃ narasiṃhmatanau dhṛte |
p. 20) vāmano gopitavapurvitatastvaṃ trivikramaḥ || 12 ||
3.d:
भयाभये त्वयैकस्यां नरसिंह्मतनौ धृते |
प्. 20) वामनो गोपितवपुर्विततस्त्वं त्रिविक्रमः || 12 ||
3.m: Fear and fearlessness were held by you in the single body of the Man-Lion; / you are Vāmana of concealed form, and the extended Trivikrama.

3.s:
rāmarūpeṇa ramyeṇa tathā rāmatrayeṇa ca |
tvayā deva jitā daityāścchannarūpāśca rākṣasāḥ || 13 ||
3.d:
रामरूपेण रम्येण तथा रामत्रयेण च |
त्वया देव जिता दैत्याश्च्छन्नरूपाश्च राक्षसाः || 13 ||
3.m: Through the lovely form of Rāma, and likewise through the three Rāmas, / O God, demons and disguised Rākṣasas were conquered by you.

3.s:
kṛṣṇastvaṃ bālarūpī ca vibhurdāmodaro hariḥ |
tvaṃ viśvarūpo devānāṃ sāṅkhyānāṃ kapilaḥ prabhuḥ || 14 ||
3.d:
कृष्णस्त्वं बालरूपी च विभुर्दामोदरो हरिः |
त्वं विश्वरूपो देवानां साङ्ख्यानां कपिलः प्रभुः || 14 ||
3.m: You are Kṛṣṇa, in the form of a child, the All-Pervading One, Dāmodara, Hari; / you are the universal form of the gods, the Lord Kapila of the Sāṅkhyas;

3.s:
yogināṃ yo gatistvaṃ vai śeṣātmā dharaṇīdharaḥ |
saṅkarṣaṇo jñānināṃ tvaṃ kāmināṃ kusumāyudhaḥ || 15 ||
3.d:
योगिनां यो गतिस्त्वं वै शेषात्मा धरणीधरः |
सङ्कर्षणो ज्ञानिनां त्वं कामिनां कुसुमायुधः || 15 ||
3.m: you are indeed the goal of yogins, the bearer of the earth whose nature is Śeṣa; / you are Saṅkarṣaṇa to the wise, the flower-weaponed [Kāma] to lovers;

3.s:
aniruddhaśca sarveṣāṃ jīvatvena tvamacyutaḥ |
tvayā sṛṣṭaṃ jagatsarvaṃ brahmatvena janārdana || 16 ||
3.d:
अनिरुद्धश्च सर्वेषां जीवत्वेन त्वमच्युतः |
त्वया सृष्टं जगत्सर्वं ब्रह्मत्वेन जनार्दन || 16 ||
3.m: and Aniruddha to all, you are Acyuta as the individual soul; / the entire universe was created by you in the form of Brahmā, O Janārdana;

3.s:
sthitaṃ pāsi svayaṃ bhūtvā viṣṇurūpeṇa keśava |
rudrarūpeṇa govinda jagatsaṃharase kṣaṇāt || 17 ||
3.d:
स्थितं पासि स्वयं भूत्वा विष्णुरूपेण केशव |
रुद्ररूपेण गोविन्द जगत्संहरसे क्षणात् || 17 ||
3.m: having yourself become [preserver], you protect what exists in the form of Viṣṇu, O Keśava; / in the form of Rudra, O Govinda, you destroy the universe in an instant.

3.s:
yajñarūpeṇa devānāṃ havyaṃ vahnimukhena ca |
vahasi tvaṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca kavyaṃ kṛtsnaṃ jagatpate || 18 ||
3.d:
यज्ञरूपेण देवानां हव्यं वह्निमुखेन च |
वहसि त्वं पितॄणां च कव्यं कृत्स्नं जगत्पते || 18 ||
3.m: In the form of sacrifice, through the mouth of fire, you convey the sacrificial oblation / to the gods, and the whole ancestral offering to the ancestors, O Lord of the Universe!

3.s:
ārādhayāmi tvāṃ bhaktyā bhavanirvāṇadaṃ prabhum |
surasaukhyakaraṃ devaṃ surāṇāmamṛtapradam || 19 ||
3.d:
आराधयामि त्वां भक्त्या भवनिर्वाणदं प्रभुम् |
सुरसौख्यकरं देवं सुराणाममृतप्रदम् || 19 ||
3.m: I worship you with devotion, the Lord who grants release from transmigratory existence, / the God who gives happiness to the gods and bestows nectar upon the gods."

3.s:
sthitāstvadudare lokā dvīpāścodadhibhissaha |
devaiśca dānavaiḥsārddhamṛṣibhiśca tapodhanaiḥ || 20 ||
3.d:
स्थितास्त्वदुदरे लोका द्वीपाश्चोदधिभिस्सह |
देवैश्च दानवैःसार्द्धमृषिभिश्च तपोधनैः || 20 ||
3.m: The worlds are situated within your belly, along with the continents and oceans, / together with the gods, the Dānavas, and the sages whose wealth is ascetic penance,

3.s:
manujairdanujaiścaiva saridbhissaha parvataiḥ |
tavāntassaṃsthitaṃ sarvaṃ sarvasyāntarbhavān sthitaḥ || 21 ||
3.d:
मनुजैर्दनुजैश्चैव सरिद्भिस्सह पर्वतैः |
तवान्तस्संस्थितं सर्वं सर्वस्यान्तर्भवान् स्थितः || 21 ||
3.m: with humans and Danujas, with rivers and mountains. / Everything is situated within you, and you dwell within everything.

3.s:
tvamādyo bhuvanasyāsya tvāṃ smṛtvā sukhitā vayam |
bhavāmo nityasaṃbuddhāḥ saṃsthitā yatra kutracit || 22 ||
3.d:
त्वमाद्यो भुवनस्यास्य त्वां स्मृत्वा सुखिता वयम् |
भवामो नित्यसंबुद्धाः संस्थिता यत्र कुत्रचित् || 22 ||
3.m: You are the primal origin of this universe. Remembering you, we become happy / and eternally awakened, wherever we may be situated.

3.s:
praṇavastvaṃ trimātraśca bhūrbhuvasvastvameva ca |
ahaṅkārakarastvaṃ vai tritayaṃ lokatārakam || 23 ||
3.d:
प्रणवस्त्वं त्रिमात्रश्च भूर्भुवस्वस्त्वमेव च |
अहङ्कारकरस्त्वं वै त्रितयं लोकतारकम् || 23 ||
3.m: You are the praṇava with its three morae, and you alone are Bhūḥ, Bhuvaḥ, and Svaḥ. / You produce self-consciousness; you indeed are the triad that carries the world across.

3.s:
[bhagavadrūpadidṛkṣayā lokasṛṣṭiprakārajijñāsayā ca nāradakṛtā
prārthanā]
3.d:
[भगवद्रूपदिदृक्षया लोकसृष्टिप्रकारजिज्ञासया च नारदकृता
प्रार्थना]
3.m: [Nārada's prayer out of desire to see the Lord's form and to know the manner of the world's creation]

3.s:
tadenamādiśasvāśu bhavādyenottarāmyaham |
adhiṣṭhāya parāṃ buddhiṃ bhūyaḥśreyo'hamāpnuyām || 24 ||
3.d:
तदेनमादिशस्वाशु भवाद्येनोत्तराम्यहम् |
अधिष्ठाय परां बुद्धिं भूयःश्रेयोऽहमाप्नुयाम् || 24 ||
3.m: Therefore, teach this quickly to me, so that I may cross over transmigratory existence, / and that, having attained the highest intellect, I may obtain supreme welfare.

3.s:
mama bhaktasya deveśa paraṃ jñānātmakāṃkṣiṇaḥ |
saṃsārabhayabhītasya rūpaṃ vai svaṃ pradarśaya || 25 ||
3.d:
मम भक्तस्य देवेश परं ज्ञानात्मकांक्षिणः |
संसारभयभीतस्य रूपं वै स्वं प्रदर्शय || 25 ||
3.m: To me, your devotee, O Lord of Gods, who desires [the knowledge] consisting of the supreme knowledge / and is terrified by the fear of transmigratory existence, show your own form!

3.s:
sṛṣṭaṃ tvayā yathā sarvamābrahmabhavanāntimam |
p. 21) gaganañcātimāyena dustaraṃ tadvadasva me || 26 ||
3.d:
सृष्टं त्वया यथा सर्वमाब्रह्मभवनान्तिमम् |
प्. 21) गगनञ्चातिमायेन दुस्तरं तद्वदस्व मे || 26 ||
3.m: Tell me that—how everything up to the abode of Brahmā / and the sky, impassable with immense māyā, was created by you!

3.s: [bhgavatā kṛtaṃ sakalaniṣkalātmakasvīyarūpadvayapradarśanam]
3.d: [भ्गवता कृतं सकलनिष्कलात्मकस्वीयरूपद्वयप्रदर्शनम्]
3.m: [The Lord's showing of his twofold form consisting of the qualified and the unqualified]

3.s: śāṇḍilyaḥ-
3.d: शाण्डिल्यः-

3.s:
iti sañcodito bhaktyā parayā parameśvaraḥ |
viśuddhabuddhinā samyak nāradena surarṣiṇā || 27 ||
3.d:
इति सञ्चोदितो भक्त्या परया परमेश्वरः |
विशुद्धबुद्धिना सम्यक् नारदेन सुरर्षिणा || 27 ||
3.m: Having been thus urged with supreme devotion by the divine sage Nārada, / who was of completely purified intellect, the Supreme Lord,

3.s:
taduktasya kṣaṇe tasminnātmīyo gahanaśca yaḥ |
pradarśitassa hariṇā sakalo niṣkalātmakaḥ || 28 ||
3.d:
तदुक्तस्य क्षणे तस्मिन्नात्मीयो गहनश्च यः |
प्रदर्शितस्स हरिणा सकलो निष्कलात्मकः || 28 ||
3.m: at that instant, showed his own profound [form] described by him, / which is both qualified and unqualified in nature.

3.s:
paritoṣaṃ paraṃ yāto munirbrahmasutastadā |
uvāca parayā prītyā bhūyassa vinayānvitaḥ || 29 ||
3.d:
परितोषं परं यातो मुनिर्ब्रह्मसुतस्तदा |
उवाच परया प्रीत्या भूयस्स विनयान्वितः || 29 ||
3.m: Having attained supreme contentment, the sage, the son of Brahmā, / then spoke again with supreme joy, filled with modesty:

3.s:
tvatprasādānmayā jñātaṃ durlabhaṃ yatsurairapi |
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi sambhūtiṃ vibhavaṃ tava || 30 ||
3.d:
त्वत्प्रसादान्मया ज्ञातं दुर्लभं यत्सुरैरपि |
इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामि सम्भूतिं विभवं तव || 30 ||
3.m: "By your grace I have understood what is difficult even for the gods to obtain. / Now I wish to hear about your manifestation and sovereign power."

3.s: [lokasya sṛṣṭipralayakālau]
3.d: [लोकस्य सृष्टिप्रलयकालौ]
3.m: [The times of creation and dissolution of the world]

3.s: śrībhagavānuvāca-
3.d: श्रीभगवानुवाच-

3.s:
yadidaṃ paśyasi brahmanmāyayā nirmitaṃ jagat |
kālādibahubhirbhedairbhinnaṃ nānāsvarūpakaiḥ || 31 ||
3.d:
यदिदं पश्यसि ब्रह्मन्मायया निर्मितं जगत् |
कालादिबहुभिर्भेदैर्भिन्नं नानास्वरूपकैः || 31 ||
3.m: "O Brahman, this world that you see, fashioned by māyā, / divided by manifold distinctions such as time, possessing various forms—

3.s:
māmake prabhavo hyahni pralayaśca niśāgame |
divyaṃ yugasahasraṃ ca madīyaṃ viddhi vāsaram || 32 ||
3.d:
मामके प्रभवो ह्यह्नि प्रलयश्च निशागमे |
दिव्यं युगसहस्रं च मदीयं विद्धि वासरम् || 32 ||
3.m: its arising takes place during my day, and its dissolution at the arrival of night. / Know that my day lasts a thousand divine yugas,

3.s:
rātriśca tāvatī jñeyā evaṃrūpe kṣaye sati |
pravartamāne tvahani kāle sargākhyalakṣaṇe || 33 ||
3.d:
रात्रिश्च तावती ज्ञेया एवंरूपे क्षये सति |
प्रवर्तमाने त्वहनि काले सर्गाख्यलक्षणे || 33 ||
3.m: and the night is to be known as equally long. When such a destruction has occurred, / and the day is proceeding at the time characterized as creation,

3.s: [bhagavato nābhīkamalāt caturmukhasṛṣṭiḥ]
3.d: [भगवतो नाभीकमलात् चतुर्मुखसृष्टिः]
3.m: [Creation of the four-faced Brahmā from the navel-lotus of the Lord]

3.s:
svakāraṇamanirjitya kāryārthaṃ munipuṅgava |
jñānayogaprabhāvena ammayaṃ mahimāvṛtam || 34 ||
3.d:
स्वकारणमनिर्जित्य कार्यार्थं मुनिपुङ्गव |
ज्ञानयोगप्रभावेन अम्मयं महिमावृतम् || 34 ||
3.m: without subjugating my own material cause, for the sake of the effect, O best of sages, / by the power of the yoga of knowledge, [a lotus] made of water and surrounded by greatness,

3.s:
preritaṃ nābhirandhreṇa mayā hārdaṃ kuśeśayam |
vijñaptimātrarūpaṃ yanmamāntaḥkaraṇasthitam || 35 ||
3.d:
प्रेरितं नाभिरन्ध्रेण मया हार्दं कुशेशयम् |
विज्ञप्तिमात्ररूपं यन्ममान्तःकरणस्थितम् || 35 ||
3.m: was propelled by me through the opening of the navel, the lotus of the heart / consisting of mere consciousness, which was dwelling in my inner organ,

3.s:
sahasrārkapratīkāśaṃ sahasraśaśikesaram |
sahasravaṃhnigarbhaṃ ca hemanālaṃ mahāprabham || 36 ||
3.d:
सहस्रार्कप्रतीकाशं सहस्रशशिकेसरम् |
सहस्रवंह्निगर्भं च हेमनालं महाप्रभम् || 36 ||
3.m: resembling a thousand suns, with filaments like a thousand moons, / containing a thousand fires within, possessing a golden stalk and great splendour.

3.s: tanmadhye mānavo(so ?) brahmā mayā sṛṣṭaścaturmukhaḥ |
3.d: तन्मध्ये मानवो(सो ?) ब्रह्मा मया सृष्टश्चतुर्मुखः |
3.m: In its middle, the four-faced Brahmā was created by me out of mind.

3.s: [tasya caturmukhasya vidyāśaktiviśeṣayogaḥ]
3.d: [तस्य चतुर्मुखस्य विद्याशक्तिविशेषयोगः]
3.m: [The four-faced Brahmā's endowment with the special power of knowledge]

3.s: jagatāṃ prabhavastasmādvidyādehassanātanaḥ || 37 ||
3.d: जगतां प्रभवस्तस्माद्विद्यादेहस्सनातनः || 37 ||
3.m: The eternal [Brahmā], the origin of the worlds, possessing a body of knowledge,

3.s:
p. 22) sarvasaṃskārasaṃpūrṇo vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ |
aṇimādyaṣṭakopetassisṛkṣāśaktibhiryutaḥ || 38 ||
3.d:
प्. 22) सर्वसंस्कारसंपूर्णो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः |
अणिमाद्यष्टकोपेतस्सिसृक्षाशक्तिभिर्युतः || 38 ||
3.m: complete with all ritual purifications, a master of the Vedas and auxiliary sciences, / endowed with the eight [supernormal powers] beginning with atomicity, possessing the powers of the desire to create—

3.s: [rajoguṇodrekāt tatkṛtā vividhasṛṣṭiḥ]
3.d: [रजोगुणोद्रेकात् तत्कृता विविधसृष्टिः]
3.m: [The diverse creation performed by him due to the preponderance of rajas]

3.s:
na tasya viditaścāhaṃ yadā yātassagarvatām |
asmīti pratyayaṃ labdhvā rajasā kaluṣīkṛtaḥ || 39 ||
3.d:
न तस्य विदितश्चाहं यदा यातस्सगर्वताम् |
अस्मीति प्रत्ययं लब्ध्वा रजसा कलुषीकृतः || 39 ||
3.m: I was not known to him when he became filled with pride, / having acquired the notion 'I am,' defiled by rajas.

3.s:
tadā cakāra vividhāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ svāmā(tmā ?)nupūrvikām |
nyagbhūtabhūtapūrvāṇi sthūlasūkṣmāṇi yāni ca || 40 ||
3.d:
तदा चकार विविधां सृष्टिं स्वामा(त्मा ?)नुपूर्विकाम् |
न्यग्भूतभूतपूर्वाणि स्थूलसूक्ष्माणि यानि च || 40 ||
3.m: Then he performed the diverse creation in his own order: / those gross and subtle beings that had previously been submerged,

3.s:
cetanācetanākhyāni vyañjitāni krameṇa tu |
devāścānekabhedena manuṣyāḥ paśavastathā || 41 ||
3.d:
चेतनाचेतनाख्यानि व्यञ्जितानि क्रमेण तु |
देवाश्चानेकभेदेन मनुष्याः पशवस्तथा || 41 ||
3.m: called animate and inanimate, were manifested in gradual sequence: / the gods with their manifold divisions, humans, and beasts,

3.s:
sthāvarāntāni sarvāṇi santyasminyāni kānicit |
svaniketāni sarvāṇi dṛṣṭvā svasminpitāmahaḥ || 42 ||
3.d:
स्थावरान्तानि सर्वाणि सन्त्यस्मिन्यानि कानिचित् |
स्वनिकेतानि सर्वाणि दृष्ट्वा स्वस्मिन्पितामहः || 42 ||
3.m: and whatever beings exist in this [universe] ending with immobile life. / Seeing all those residing in their own abodes within himself, the Grandfather,

3.s:
[rajaḥprakarṣādabhibhūtasattvatayā caturmukhasya
lokadhāraṇe'sāmarthyam]
3.d:
[रजःप्रकर्षादभिभूतसत्त्वतया चतुर्मुखस्य
लोकधारणेऽसामर्थ्यम्]
3.m: [The inability of the four-faced Brahmā to support the world due to the eclipse of sattva by the predominance of rajas]

3.s:
svā(sva ?)lokaṃ rāgabāhulyātsamyagdhartuṃ na vetyasau |
kṛtākṛtaṃ jagatyasminvinā sattvodayena tu || 43 ||
3.d:
स्वा(स्व ?)लोकं रागबाहुल्यात्सम्यग्धर्तुं न वेत्यसौ |
कृताकृतं जगत्यस्मिन्विना सत्त्वोदयेन तु || 43 ||
3.m: owing to the abundance of passion, did not properly know how to sustain his own world, / [nor] what was to be done and what was not to be done in this universe, without the arising of sattva.

3.s: [bhūmerdhāraṇāya bhagavato yoganidrāśrayaṇam]
3.d: [भूमेर्धारणाय भगवतो योगनिद्राश्रयणम्]
3.m: [The Lord's resorting to yoganidrā to sustain the earth]

3.s:
sampādyaivaṃ mahārūpamātmīyaṃ paṅkajānvitam |
jalāntarvartitaṃ bhūmeḥ kṛtvā santā(ndhā ?)raṇārthataḥ || 44 ||
3.d:
सम्पाद्यैवं महारूपमात्मीयं पङ्कजान्वितम् |
जलान्तर्वर्तितं भूमेः कृत्वा सन्ता(न्धा ?)रणार्थतः || 44 ||
3.m: Having thus produced my own great form endowed with a lotus, / situated within the waters for the purpose of sustaining the earth,

3.s: yoganidrāṃ samāśritya sthito'haṃ dvijasattama |
3.d: योगनिद्रां समाश्रित्य स्थितोऽहं द्विजसत्तम |
3.m: having resorted to yogic sleep, I remained, O best of the twice-born.

3.s: [madhukaiṭabhāsurayorutpattiḥ, tābhyāṃ kṛtaḥ sarvalokavijayaḥ]
3.d: [मधुकैटभासुरयोरुत्पत्तिः, ताभ्यां कृतः सर्वलोकविजयः]
3.m: [The birth of the demons Madhu and Kaiṭabha, and their conquest of all the worlds]

3.s: brahmaṇo jāyamānasya hyabhūtāṃ svedabindukau || 45 ||
3.d: ब्रह्मणो जायमानस्य ह्यभूतां स्वेदबिन्दुकौ || 45 ||
3.m: As Brahmā was being born, two drops of sweat arose.

3.s:
padmanālaṃ samāśritya saṃsthitāvudarāntare |
tadotthitau durādharṣau nāmnā dvau madhukaiṭabhau || 46 ||
3.d:
पद्मनालं समाश्रित्य संस्थितावुदरान्तरे |
तदोत्थितौ दुराधर्षौ नाम्ना द्वौ मधुकैटभौ || 46 ||
3.m: Clinging to the lotus stalk, situated inside the belly, / there arose then two invincible [demons] named Madhu and Kaiṭabha,

3.s:
kāmakrodhātmakau caiva tamasā'tīva nirbharau |
tāmasenābhimānena vṛddhiyuktau kṛtau sthitau || 47 ||
3.d:
कामक्रोधात्मकौ चैव तमसाऽतीव निर्भरौ |
तामसेनाभिमानेन वृद्धियुक्तौ कृतौ स्थितौ || 47 ||
3.m: consisting of desire and anger, filled exceedingly with tamas, / growing in power and firmly established through tāmasa egotism.

3.s:
kimidaṃ tasya padmasya kalpayantau parasparam |
kautukābhiniviṣṭau tu pātālatalamāśritau || 48 ||
3.d:
किमिदं तस्य पद्मस्य कल्पयन्तौ परस्परम् |
कौतुकाभिनिविष्टौ तु पातालतलमाश्रितौ || 48 ||
3.m: Wondering to each other, 'What is this lotus?', / seized by curiosity, they resorted to the depths of Pātāla.

3.s:
bhūyastasmācca pātālātkālavaiśvānarāvadhi |
kṛtvātha taijasīṃ māyāṃ yātāvagneradhastu tau || 49 ||
3.d:
भूयस्तस्माच्च पातालात्कालवैश्वानरावधि |
कृत्वाथ तैजसीं मायां यातावग्नेरधस्तु तौ || 49 ||
3.m: Further, having produced a fiery māyā from that Pātāla / as far as the fire of time, the two went beneath that fire.

3.s:
p. 23) nānto'sti padmanālasya tejojvālāvṛtasya ca |
garvānmohaṃ gatau kiñcidyadā bhūyastadā dvija || 50 ||
3.d:
प्. 23) नान्तोऽस्ति पद्मनालस्य तेजोज्वालावृतस्य च |
गर्वान्मोहं गतौ किञ्चिद्यदा भूयस्तदा द्विज || 50 ||
3.m: There was no end to the lotus stalk surrounded by flames of fire. / When, out of pride, they fell into a slight bewilderment, then, O twice-born,

3.s:
matiṃ kṛtvordhvagamane prāptāvūrdhvaṃ mayā tataḥ |
sa padmo'ntarhitaścaiva tataścotpannavismayau || 51 ||
3.d:
मतिं कृत्वोर्ध्वगमने प्राप्तावूर्ध्वं मया ततः |
स पद्मोऽन्तर्हितश्चैव ततश्चोत्पन्नविस्मयौ || 51 ||
3.m: having resolved to go upward, they reached the heights; then, by me, / that lotus was concealed, and thereupon the two were struck with wonder.

3.s:
sthitau tu tau mahāghorau kva gatassa ca paṅkajaḥ |
protthitau toyamadhyācca paśyetāṃ pṛthivīmimām || 52 ||
3.d:
स्थितौ तु तौ महाघोरौ क्व गतस्स च पङ्कजः |
प्रोत्थितौ तोयमध्याच्च पश्येतां पृथिवीमिमाम् || 52 ||
3.m: Those two dreadful ones stood wondering: 'Where has that lotus gone?' / Having emerged from the middle of the waters, they beheld this earth.

3.s:
cakraturmatimūrddheṣu lokeṣu gamanaṃ prati |
dṛṣṭvā ca vibhavaṃ sarvaṃ buddhirāsīttayostadā || 53 ||
3.d:
चक्रतुर्मतिमूर्द्धेषु लोकेषु गमनं प्रति |
दृष्ट्वा च विभवं सर्वं बुद्धिरासीत्तयोस्तदा || 53 ||
3.m: They resolved to travel to the upper worlds, / and seeing all that splendor, the thought then occurred to them

3.s:
kṣmādau sarveṣu lokeṣu samyaksvīkaraṇaṃ prati |
nirjitāśca tatassarve lokā lokāntarāṇyapi || 54 ||
3.d:
क्ष्मादौ सर्वेषु लोकेषु सम्यक्स्वीकरणं प्रति |
निर्जिताश्च ततस्सर्वे लोका लोकान्तराण्यपि || 54 ||
3.m: to thoroughly seize all the worlds, beginning with the earth; / and then all the worlds and other realms were conquered [by them].

3.s: tamasā'tīva kaṣṭena vyāptaṃ sarvaṃ carācaram |
3.d: तमसाऽतीव कष्टेन व्याप्तं सर्वं चराचरम् |
3.m: Everything moving and unmoving was pervaded by severe darkness.

3.s:
[tābhyāṃ kṛtena vedāpahāreṇa caturmukhasya
jñānabhraṃśādadharmavṛddhyā lokasya duravasthāprāptiḥ]
3.d:
[ताभ्यां कृतेन वेदापहारेण चतुर्मुखस्य
ज्ञानभ्रंशादधर्मवृद्ध्या लोकस्य दुरवस्थाप्राप्तिः]
3.m: [The degradation of the world through the loss of knowledge of the four-faced Brahmā caused by their theft of the Vedas and the increase of unrighteousness]

3.s: hṛtavedaḥ kṛto brahmā abhūdanyastu tatkṣaṇāt || 55 ||
3.d: हृतवेदः कृतो ब्रह्मा अभूदन्यस्तु तत्क्षणात् || 55 ||
3.m: Brahmā, robbed of the Vedas, instantly became another [person].

3.s:
vedairvinā yato vipra vedaṃ cakṣuḥ purā śritaḥ |
asthitiṃ jagataḥ kṛtvā adharmasthāpanaṃ mahat || 56 ||
3.d:
वेदैर्विना यतो विप्र वेदं चक्षुः पुरा श्रितः |
अस्थितिं जगतः कृत्वा अधर्मस्थापनं महत् || 56 ||
3.m: For without the Vedas, O twice-born, [he who had] formerly relied on the Veda as his eye / caused the destabilization of the universe and the great establishment of unrighteousness.

3.s: tatastau tāmasau duṣṭau jalamadhyaṃ punargatau |
3.d: ततस्तौ तामसौ दुष्टौ जलमध्यं पुनर्गतौ |
3.m: Then those two evil, tāmasa [demons] went back into the middle of the water.

3.s: [munibhiḥ kṛtaṃ caturmukhasyodbodhanam]
3.d: [मुनिभिः कृतं चतुर्मुखस्योद्बोधनम्]
3.m: [The awakening of the four-faced Brahmā by the sages]

3.s: tadā sambodhito brahmā devatairmunibhissaha || 57 ||
3.d: तदा सम्बोधितो ब्रह्मा देवतैर्मुनिभिस्सह || 57 ||
3.m: Then Brahmā was awakened by the gods together with the sages.

3.s:
saṃsmarasvādidevaṃ tvaṃ samudbhūto'bjasambhava |
sa naḥ śreyaḥprado nānyo yadi syātsatyatā śruteḥ || 58 ||
3.d:
संस्मरस्वादिदेवं त्वं समुद्भूतोऽब्जसम्भव |
स नः श्रेयःप्रदो नान्यो यदि स्यात्सत्यता श्रुतेः || 58 ||
3.m:
"Remember the primal god from whom you were born, O lotus-born one!
He alone bestows our welfare, none other, if the Vedic revelation is true.

3.s:
na tvayā sābhimānena jñātaṃ paramakāraṇam |
yenā'narthamidaṃ kaṣṭaṃ jagatyasminpratiṣṭhitam || 59 ||
3.d:
न त्वया साभिमानेन ज्ञातं परमकारणम् |
येनाऽनर्थमिदं कष्टं जगत्यस्मिन्प्रतिष्ठितम् || 59 ||
3.m:
Because of pride, you did not recognize the ultimate cause,
on account of which this grievous calamity has settled upon this world.

3.s:
kāraṇaṃ te sa bhagavāṃstvamasmākaṃ ca kāraṇam |
paramaṃ kāraṇaṃ viṣṇumajeyaṃ smara padmaja || 60 ||
3.d:
कारणं ते स भगवांस्त्वमस्माकं च कारणम् |
परमं कारणं विष्णुमजेयं स्मर पद्मज || 60 ||
3.m:
The Lord is your cause, and you are our cause;
remember the ultimate cause, Viṣṇu the unconquerable, O lotus-born one!"

3.s: [munibhirudbodhitena caturmukhena kṛtā bhagavatstutiḥ]
3.d: [मुनिभिरुद्बोधितेन चतुर्मुखेन कृता भगवत्स्तुतिः]
3.m: [Praise of the Lord uttered by the four-faced Brahmā upon being awakened by the sages]

3.s:
tataśśāntarajā brahmā satvaikagatamānasaḥ |
abhūtstutiparassarvairdevatairmunibhissaha || 61 ||
3.d:
ततश्शान्तरजा ब्रह्मा सत्वैकगतमानसः |
अभूत्स्तुतिपरस्सर्वैर्देवतैर्मुनिभिस्सह || 61 ||
3.m:
Then Brahmā, his rajas stilled, his mind fixed solely on sattva,
became absorbed in praise together with all the gods and sages.

3.s:
praṇaṣṭavedadharmo'haṃ na me'sti gatiracyuta |
pāhi pāhītyabhīkṣṇaṃ sa atyārtaśca yadā'bravīt || 62 ||
3.d:
प्रणष्टवेदधर्मोऽहं न मेऽस्ति गतिरच्युत |
पाहि पाहीत्यभीक्ष्णं स अत्यार्तश्च यदाऽब्रवीत् || 62 ||
3.m:
When, deeply afflicted, he cried out repeatedly:
"My Vedic order is destroyed! I have no refuge, O Acyuta! Protect me, protect me!"

3.s: p. 24) [bhagavatā kṛtamabhayapradānam]
3.d: प्. 24) [भगवता कृतमभयप्रदानम्]
3.m: [The granting of fearlessness by the Lord]

3.s:
tadā viprāvatīrṇo'haṃ mamatve glānimāgate ||
praṇaṣṭeṣu ca vedeṣu brahmaṇyabrahmatāṃ gate || 63 ||
3.d:
तदा विप्रावतीर्णोऽहं ममत्वे ग्लानिमागते ||
प्रणष्टेषु च वेदेषु ब्रह्मण्यब्रह्मतां गते || 63 ||
3.m:
"Then, O twice-born one, I descended, when his sense of mineness had fallen into dejection,
when the Vedas were lost, and Brahmā had lapsed from being Brahman.

3.s:
dattaṃ mayā'bhayaṃ teṣāṃ samāśvastamidaṃ jagat |
vidyā māyātmakaṃ rūpaṃ dvividhaṃ ca mayā kṛtam || 64 ||
3.d:
दत्तं मयाऽभयं तेषां समाश्वस्तमिदं जगत् |
विद्या मायात्मकं रूपं द्विविधं च मया कृतम् || 64 ||
3.m:
Fearlessness was granted by me to them, and this world was reassured;
and I assumed a twofold form consisting of knowledge and of māyā.

3.s:
[vidyāmayarūpaṃ parigṛhya bhagavatā viracitaṃ
pātālādvedānāmuddharaṇam]
3.d:
[विद्यामयरूपं परिगृह्य भगवता विरचितं
पातालाद्वेदानामुद्धरणम्]
3.m: [The retrieval of the Vedas from Pātāla by the Lord assuming a form composed of knowledge]

3.s:
vidyāmayena rūpeṇa śabdabrahmamayena ca |
pātālāntargatā vedāssvīkṛtāḥ praṇavena tu || 65 ||
3.d:
विद्यामयेन रूपेण शब्दब्रह्ममयेन च |
पातालान्तर्गता वेदास्स्वीकृताः प्रणवेन तु || 65 ||
3.m:
Through that form consisting of knowledge and consisting of sonic Brahman,
the Vedas that had gone down into Pātāla were reclaimed by means of the praṇava.

3.s:
[vidyāmayarūpasya bhagavato'nupraveśāccaturmukhasya
vedāvadhāraṇam]
3.d:
[विद्यामयरूपस्य भगवतोऽनुप्रवेशाच्चतुर्मुखस्य
वेदावधारणम्]
3.m: [Brahmā's comprehension of the Vedas upon the Lord entering him with the form consisting of knowledge]

3.s:
saṃpraviṣṭastataścāhamimāṃ pa(pā ?)dmodbhavīṃ tanum |
labdhasaṃjñena tenātha vedā hyāvartitāḥ punaḥ || 66 ||
3.d:
संप्रविष्टस्ततश्चाहमिमां प(पा ?)द्मोद्भवीं तनुम् |
लब्धसंज्ञेन तेनाथ वेदा ह्यावर्तिताः पुनः || 66 ||
3.m:
Then I entered this body of the lotus-born [Brahmā];
and once he had regained consciousness, the Vedas were recited by him again.

3.s:
tadā bhuvananāthāśca sarve hṛṣṭatamāḥ sthitāḥ |
tamomohabhayānmuktāḥ svakaṃ sthānaṃ samāśritāḥ || 67 ||
3.d:
तदा भुवननाथाश्च सर्वे हृष्टतमाः स्थिताः |
तमोमोहभयान्मुक्ताः स्वकं स्थानं समाश्रिताः || 67 ||
3.m:
Then all the rulers of the worlds remained filled with supreme joy;
freed from the fear of darkness and delusion, they repaired to their own realms.

3.s:
[māyāmayaṃ rūpaṃ parigṛhya tābhyāṃ saha bhagavato
yuddhācaraṇam]
3.d:
[मायामयं रूपं परिगृह्य ताभ्यां सह भगवतो
युद्धाचरणम्]
3.m: [The Lord waging battle against the two demons upon assuming a form of māyā]

3.s:
dvitīyena tu rūpeṇa tayoragre sthito'bhavam |
tau tu duṣṭau madonmattau mama yuddhābhilāṣiṇau || 68 ||
3.d:
द्वितीयेन तु रूपेण तयोरग्रे स्थितोऽभवम् |
तौ तु दुष्टौ मदोन्मत्तौ मम युद्धाभिलाषिणौ || 68 ||
3.m:
With the second form, however, I stood before the two demons;
and those two wicked ones, drunk with arrogance, wished to fight with me.

3.s:
tato māyātmakenaiva vapuṣā'nekabāhunā |
bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi yodhitau tau tadā mayā || 69 ||
3.d:
ततो मायात्मकेनैव वपुषाऽनेकबाहुना |
बहून्यब्दसहस्राणि योधितौ तौ तदा मया || 69 ||
3.m:
Then, with that very body composed of māyā, possessing many arms,
the two were fought by me for many thousands of years.

3.s: [tayorajeyatvamālakṣya mantramayarūpaṃ parigṛhya tayorhananam]
3.d: [तयोरजेयत्वमालक्ष्य मन्त्रमयरूपं परिगृह्य तयोर्हननम्]
3.m: [Noticing their invincibility, slaying them by assuming a form composed of mantra]

3.s:
jñātvā tayorajeyatvamahamantarhito dvija |
tato mantramayaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtvā śaktyātmakaṃ mahat || 70 ||
3.d:
ज्ञात्वा तयोरजेयत्वमहमन्तर्हितो द्विज |
ततो मन्त्रमयं रूपं कृत्वा शक्त्यात्मकं महत् || 70 ||
3.m:
Recognizing their invincibility, O twice-born one, I vanished;
then, having assumed a great form composed of mantra, consisting of power,

3.s:
tattābhyāṃ caiva durdharṣaṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ tathā'rkavat |
līlayā karayugmena gṛhītvā kaṇṭhato mayā || 71 ||
3.d:
तत्ताभ्यां चैव दुर्धर्षं दुर्निरीक्ष्यं तथाऽर्कवत् |
लीलया करयुग्मेन गृहीत्वा कण्ठतो मया || 71 ||
3.m:
which was unassailable by those two and difficult to look upon like the sun,
seizing them playfully by the throat with both hands,

3.s: r-ūrūbhyāṃ marditau caiva yayurniṣkaṇṭakāssurāḥ |
3.d: र्-ऊरूभ्यां मर्दितौ चैव ययुर्निष्कण्टकास्सुराः |
3.m: and crushing them with my two thighs, the gods became free of obstacles.

3.s: [medinīśabdanirvacanam]
3.d: [मेदिनीशब्दनिर्वचनम्]
3.m: [Etymology of the word 'medinī']

3.s: tadudbhūtena medena paripūrṇā vasundharā || 72 ||
3.d: तदुद्भूतेन मेदेन परिपूर्णा वसुन्धरा || 72 ||
3.m: The earth was filled with the fat produced from them;

3.s:
tataḥ prabhṛti kālācca medinīti nirucyate |
ityeṣa kathitassargo mune brāhmo mayā tava || 73 ||
3.d:
ततः प्रभृति कालाच्च मेदिनीति निरुच्यते |
इत्येष कथितस्सर्गो मुने ब्राह्मो मया तव || 73 ||
3.m:
and from that time onward it is called 'medinī.'
Thus has this creation of Brahmā been told by me to you, O sage.

3.s:
anye hyanekarūpāśca sargā bahutarā gatāḥ |
īdṛkprakāśāḥ sthūlāśca yeṣā saṅkhyā na vidyate || 74 ||
3.d:
अन्ये ह्यनेकरूपाश्च सर्गा बहुतरा गताः |
ईदृक्प्रकाशाः स्थूलाश्च येषा सङ्ख्या न विद्यते || 74 ||
3.m:
Indeed, very many other creations of diverse forms have passed,
similar in manifestation and gross, which cannot be numbered.

3.s:
p. 25) prādhāniko dvijā'syādyastasyādyo vaiṣṇavaḥ paraḥ |
kimanyatkathayiṣyāmi brūhi yavāsti saṃśayaḥ || 75 ||
3.d:
प्. 25) प्राधानिको द्विजाऽस्याद्यस्तस्याद्यो वैष्णवः परः |
किमन्यत्कथयिष्यामि ब्रूहि यवास्ति संशयः || 75 ||
3.m:
The creation from pradhāna is the primary one here, O twice-born one, and prior to it is the supreme creation of Viṣṇu.
What else shall I tell? Speak, wherever your doubt lies!

3.s: adyāpi munirśārdūla tadahaṃ pravravībhi te |
3.d: अद्यापि मुनिर्शार्दूल तदहं प्रव्रवीभि ते |
3.m: Even now, O tiger among sages, I shall declare that to you."

3.s:
iti śrīpāñcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ brahmasargākhyānaṃ nāma
dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ || 2 ||
3.d:
इति श्रीपाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहितायां ब्रह्मसर्गाख्यानं नाम
द्वितीयः पटलः || 2 ||
3.m: Thus ends the second chapter, named 'The Account of Brahmā's Creation,' in the venerable Jayākhyasaṃhitā of the Pāñcarātra. || 2

4.s: atha pradhānasargākhyānaṃ nāma tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ
4.d: अथ प्रधानसर्गाख्यानं नाम तृतीयः पटलः
4.m: Now begins the third chapter, named 'The Account of Creation from Pradhāna.'

4.s: nāradaḥ-
4.d: नारदः-

4.s:
bhagavandevadeveśa lokanātha jagatpate |
vrūhi prādhānikaṃ sargaṃ sthūlasyāsya hi yaḥ paraḥ || 1 ||
4.d:
भगवन्देवदेवेश लोकनाथ जगत्पते |
व्रूहि प्राधानिकं सर्गं स्थूलस्यास्य हि यः परः || 1 ||
4.m:
"O Lord, God of gods, ruler of the worlds, master of the universe!
Tell of the creation from pradhāna, which is prior to this gross creation."

4.s: śrībhagavān-
4.d: श्रीभगवान्-

4.s: (pradhānalakṣaṇam)
4.d: (प्रधानलक्षणम्)

4.s:
anādimajamavyaktaṃ guṇatrayamayaṃ dvija |
viddhi pradīpasthānīyaṃ bhinnamekātmalakṣaṇam || 2 ||
4.d:
अनादिमजमव्यक्तं गुणत्रयमयं द्विज |
विद्धि प्रदीपस्थानीयं भिन्नमेकात्मलक्षणम् || 2 ||
4.m:
"Know it, O twice-born one, to be beginningless, unborn, unmanifest, composed of the three attributes,
occupying the place of a lamp, differentiated, yet characterized by a single nature.

4.s: (pradhānāt kramānmahadāditattvotpattiḥ)
4.d: (प्रधानात् क्रमान्महदादितत्त्वोत्पत्तिः)
4.m: (Gradual arising of the principles from mahat onwards from pradhāna)

4.s:
vibhaktaṃ ca tadutpannaṃ kramātsattvaṃ rajastamaḥ |
guṇatrayasamūhāddhi dharmajñānādilakṣaṇā || 3 ||
4.d:
विभक्तं च तदुत्पन्नं क्रमात्सत्त्वं रजस्तमः |
गुणत्रयसमूहाद्धि धर्मज्ञानादिलक्षणा || 3 ||
4.m:
Differentiated, there arose from it in sequence sattva, rajas, and tamas;
and from the assembly of the three attributes arose buddhi, characterized by virtue, knowledge, and so on,

4.s:
buddhirbuddhimatāṃ śreṣṭha ahaṅkārastrayātmakaḥ |
prakāśātmā vikṛtyātmā bhūtātmā'tha tṛtīyakaḥ || 4 ||
4.d:
बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतां श्रेष्ठ अहङ्कारस्त्रयात्मकः |
प्रकाशात्मा विकृत्यात्मा भूतात्माऽथ तृतीयकः || 4 ||
4.m:
O best of the intelligent! Then arose ahaṅkāra of three kinds:
luminous, modifying, and the third, elemental.

4.s:
taijasāt samanaścaiva jātaṃ budhyakṣapañcakam |
śrotre tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā ghrāṇaṃ caiva krameṇa tu || 5 ||
4.d:
तैजसात् समनश्चैव जातं बुध्यक्षपञ्चकम् |
श्रोत्रे त्वक्चक्षुषी जिह्वा घ्राणं चैव क्रमेण तु || 5 ||
4.m:
From the taijasa arose the five sense faculties along with the mind:
the two ears, skin, the two eyes, tongue, and nose, in succession.

4.s:
asṛjacca vikṛtyātmā karaṇānāṃ ca pañcakam |
tacca vākpāṇipādākhyaṃ pāyūpastheti ca smṛtam || 6 ||
4.d:
असृजच्च विकृत्यात्मा करणानां च पञ्चकम् |
तच्च वाक्पाणिपादाख्यं पायूपस्थेति च स्मृतम् || 6 ||
4.m:
And the modifying [ahaṅkāra] produced the group of five organs of action:
and that is known as speech, hands, feet, anus, and genitals.

4.s:
bhūtātmā bhūtayonīnāṃ sraṣṭā viddhi sadaiva hi |
śabdasparśau tathā rūparasagandhābhidhāyinaḥ || 7 ||
4.d:
भूतात्मा भूतयोनीनां स्रष्टा विद्धि सदैव हि |
शब्दस्पर्शौ तथा रूपरसगन्धाभिधायिनः || 7 ||
4.m:
Know the elemental [ahaṅkāra] to be ever the producer of the sources of the gross elements,
denoting sound and touch, as well as form, taste, and smell.

4.s:
tejo(bhyo ?)bhūtāni jātāni khavāyvagnyudakāni ca |
pṛthivyantāni pañcaiva ekavṛddhiguṇāni ca || 8 ||
4.d:
तेजो(भ्यो ?)भूतानि जातानि खवाय्वग्न्युदकानि च |
पृथिव्यन्तानि पञ्चैव एकवृद्धिगुणानि च || 8 ||
4.m:
From them arose the gross elements: ether, wind, fire, and water,
ending with earth—just five—each having one additional attribute.

4.s: eṣa prādhānikassargaḥ prakṛtyā tu jaḍātmakaḥ |
4.d: एष प्राधानिकस्सर्गः प्रकृत्या तु जडात्मकः |
4.m: This is the creation from pradhāna, insentient by its very nature."

4.s: nāradaḥ-
4.d: नारदः-

4.s: jaḍātmakaṃ pradhānaṃ ca tadudbhūtistadātmikā || 9 ||
4.d: जडात्मकं प्रधानं च तदुद्भूतिस्तदात्मिका || 9 ||
4.m: "Pradhāna is insentient, and what arises from it shares its nature.

4.s:
p. 26) parasparajaḍānāṃ ca kīdṛśaṃ vada me prabho |
utpādyotpādakatvaṃ hi atra me saṃśayo mahān || 10 ||
4.d:
प्. 26) परस्परजडानां च कीदृशं वद मे प्रभो |
उत्पाद्योत्पादकत्वं हि अत्र मे संशयो महान् || 10 ||
4.m:
Tell me, O Lord: what sort of relation of produced and producer
can there be among things that are mutually insentient? In this I have a great doubt."

4.s: (jaḍānāṃ mitho hetuhetumadbhāve upapattiḥ)
4.d: (जडानां मिथो हेतुहेतुमद्भावे उपपत्तिः)
4.m: (Argument for the relation of cause and effect among insentient things)

4.s: śrībhagavān-
4.d: श्रीभगवान्-

4.s:
bījaṃ hyacetanaṃ yadvattathā vrīhikaṇo dvija |
anyeṣūtpādakaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tattvaṃ tattve tathaiva ca || 11 ||
4.d:
बीजं ह्यचेतनं यद्वत्तथा व्रीहिकणो द्विज |
अन्येषूत्पादकं दृष्टं तत्त्वं तत्त्वे तथैव च || 11 ||
4.m:
"Just as an insentient seed, O twice-born one, such as a grain of rice,
is seen to produce others, so it is with principle in relation to principle.

4.s:
guṇasāmyasvarūpasya rāgāderāspadasya ca |
santāna eko hyekasya cetanācetanasya ca || 12 ||
4.d:
गुणसाम्यस्वरूपस्य रागादेरास्पदस्य च |
सन्तान एको ह्येकस्य चेतनाचेतनस्य च || 12 ||
4.m:
Of that whose essential nature is the equilibrium of attributes, and which is the receptacle of attachment and the rest,
there is indeed a single continuum, one for the sentient and one for the insentient."

4.s: nāradaḥ-
4.d: नारदः-

4.s:
acetanamidaṃ nātha kathaṃ syāccetanaṃ punaḥ |
etadguṇāspadaṃ tattvaṃ yaccaikaṃ naikadhā sthitam || 13 ||
4.d:
अचेतनमिदं नाथ कथं स्याच्चेतनं पुनः |
एतद्गुणास्पदं तत्त्वं यच्चैकं नैकधा स्थितम् || 13 ||
4.m:
"O Lord, how can this insentient principle, in turn, become sentient?
For this principle, which is the substrate of the attributes and which is one, exists in many forms."

4.s: (acetane cetanāyogopapādanam)
4.d: (अचेतने चेतनायोगोपपादनम्)
4.m: (Explanation of the association of consciousness with the insentient)

4.s: śrībhagavān-
4.d: श्रीभगवान्-

4.s:
cidrūpamātmatattvaṃ yadabhinnaṃ brahmaṇi sthitam |
tenaitacchuritaṃ bhāti aciccinmayāvaddvija || 14 ||
4.d:
चिद्रूपमात्मतत्त्वं यदभिन्नं ब्रह्मणि स्थितम् |
तेनैतच्छुरितं भाति अचिच्चिन्मयावद्द्विज || 14 ||
4.m:
"The principle of the self consists of consciousness, undivided, abiding in Brahman;
pervaded by it, O twice-born one, this insentient appears as if conscious.

4.s:
yathā'yaskāntamaṇinā lohasyādhiṣṭhitaṃ tu vai |
dṛśyate valamānaṃ tu tadvadeva mayoditam || 15 ||
4.d:
यथाऽयस्कान्तमणिना लोहस्याधिष्ठितं तु वै |
दृश्यते वलमानं तु तद्वदेव मयोदितम् || 15 ||
4.m:
Just as iron, presided over by a loadstone gem,
is seen to move, exactly so is what I have declared."

4.s: nāradaḥ-
4.d: नारदः-

4.s:
cinmayasya jaḍasyāsya sambandhe heturucyate |
viruddhametaddeveśa vedmi chāyātapaṃ yathā || 16 ||
4.d:
चिन्मयस्य जडस्यास्य सम्बन्धे हेतुरुच्यते |
विरुद्धमेतद्देवेश वेद्मि छायातपं यथा || 16 ||
4.m:
"The cause for the connection of this conscious [self] with the insentient is spoken of;
[yet] this, O God of gods, I understand to be contradictory, like shadow and sunlight."

4.s: (cidacitoḥ saṃyoge bandhe viyoge ca mokṣe hetuḥ)
4.d: (चिदचितोः संयोगे बन्धे वियोगे च मोक्षे हेतुः)
4.m: (The cause for the union of the conscious and insentient in bondage and their disjunction in liberation)

4.s: śrībhagavān-
4.d: श्रीभगवान्-

4.s:
anādivāsanāyukto jīvo'yaṃ vai cidātmakaḥ |
yadvāsanāpanodārthaṃ parasmādbrahmaṇo dvija || 17 ||
4.d:
अनादिवासनायुक्तो जीवोऽयं वै चिदात्मकः |
यद्वासनापनोदार्थं परस्माद्ब्रह्मणो द्विज || 17 ||
4.m:
"This individual self, whose nature is consciousness, is endowed with beginningless latent impressions;
for the removal of whose latent impressions, O twice-born one, from the supreme Brahman—"

4.s:
taddharmadharminī sūkṣmā udetyekāntarūpiṇī |
śuddhāśuddhātmikā śuddhā paramānandarūpiṇī || 18 ||
4.d:
तद्धर्मधर्मिनी सूक्ष्मा उदेत्येकान्तरूपिणी |
शुद्धाशुद्धात्मिका शुद्धा परमानन्दरूपिणी || 18 ||
4.m: having the nature of that [Brahman's] attribute and possessor of attributes, subtle, arising of solitary form, / consisting of the pure and impure, pure, consisting of supreme bliss, // 18

4.s:
śuddhasargakrameṇaitya ādhyātmyātmani tiṣṭhati |
karuṇodadhirūpeṇa bhavinā mokṣadakṣame || 19 ||
4.d:
शुद्धसर्गक्रमेणैत्य आध्यात्म्यात्मनि तिष्ठति |
करुणोदधिरूपेण भविना मोक्षदक्षमे || 19 ||
4.m: having approached through the sequence of pure creation, stands within the inner self, / in the form of an ocean of compassion, able to bestow liberation on the worldly soul. // 19

4.s:
sa hi saṅkalpayāmāsa mokṣo hyasyāstu karmiṇaḥ |
tato viśvātmaśaktissā tadicchānuvidhāyinī || 20 ||
4.d:
स हि सङ्कल्पयामास मोक्षो ह्यस्यास्तु कर्मिणः |
ततो विश्वात्मशक्तिस्सा तदिच्छानुविधायिनी || 20 ||
4.m: For He resolved: 'Let there be liberation for this agent of action!' / Thereupon, that power consisting of the cosmic self, complying with His will, // 20

4.s:
p. 27) pratyakcetanamāśritya tatkṣaṇādavatiṣṭhate |
mantraśaktirivādṛśyā tayā sambodhito dvija || 21 ||
4.d:
प्. 27) प्रत्यक्चेतनमाश्रित्य तत्क्षणादवतिष्ठते |
मन्त्रशक्तिरिवादृश्या तया सम्बोधितो द्विज || 21 ||
4.m: taking recourse to the inner conscious self, stands from that very moment, / invisible like the power of a mantra; awakened by her, O twice-born one, // 21

4.s:
tviṣā'krāntasvarūpaśca pratyagātmā cidātmakaḥ |
brahmaṇyekātmatāṃ yāti karmavarge kṣayaṃ gate || 22 ||
4.d:
त्विषाऽक्रान्तस्वरूपश्च प्रत्यगात्मा चिदात्मकः |
ब्रह्मण्येकात्मतां याति कर्मवर्गे क्षयं गते || 22 ||
4.m: and with his essential nature pervaded by radiance, the inner self consisting of consciousness, / attains oneness in Brahman when the aggregate of karma has met its destruction. // 22

4.s:
tasmādvai karmaṇāṃ nāśo hyabhuktānāṃ na tasya vai |
na tvādhāraṃ vinā teṣāmabhivyaktirbhavedataḥ || 23 ||
4.d:
तस्माद्वै कर्मणां नाशो ह्यभुक्तानां न तस्य वै |
न त्वाधारं विना तेषामभिव्यक्तिर्भवेदतः || 23 ||
4.m: Therefore, indeed, there is no destruction of unexperienced karmas for him; / nor, however, can their manifestation occur without a substrate. Therefore, // 23

4.s:
tatsthā brahmakalā sā vai tatrātmānaṃ niyojayet |
māyāmaye dvijādhāre guṇādhāre tate jaḍe || 24 ||
4.d:
तत्स्था ब्रह्मकला सा वै तत्रात्मानं नियोजयेत् |
मायामये द्विजाधारे गुणाधारे तते जडे || 24 ||
4.m: that fractional power of Brahman residing therein should unite the self with that, / in the substrate consisting of māyā, O twice-born one, the substrate of attributes, extended and inert. // 24

4.s:
śaktyā saṃyojito hyātmā vettyātmīyāśca vāsanāḥ |
śubhāśubhasvarūpāśca māyādhāre sthitāssadā || 25 ||
4.d:
शक्त्या संयोजितो ह्यात्मा वेत्त्यात्मीयाश्च वासनाः |
शुभाशुभस्वरूपाश्च मायाधारे स्थितास्सदा || 25 ||
4.m: United [there] by the power, the self knows its own latent impressions, / of good and evil nature, which are always situated in the substrate of māyā. // 25

4.s:
yadā'luptaviveko vai asakto vāsanāphalam |
bhuṅkte cāśu sa bandhebhyo mukto yāti kramātparam || 26 ||
4.d:
यदाऽलुप्तविवेको वै असक्तो वासनाफलम् |
भुङ्क्ते चाशु स बन्धेभ्यो मुक्तो याति क्रमात्परम् || 26 ||
4.m: When, with discernment unlost, unattached, he experiences the fruit of latent impressions, / he is swiftly freed from bondages and gradually attains the Supreme. // 26

4.s:
nirviveko'tha rajyeta māyābhoge guṇātmake |
savāsano vāsanābhiravikāraśca badhyate || 27 ||
4.d:
निर्विवेकोऽथ रज्येत मायाभोगे गुणात्मके |
सवासनो वासनाभिरविकारश्च बध्यते || 27 ||
4.m: If devoid of discernment, however, he becomes attached to the enjoyment born of māyā, consisting of attributes; / possessed of latent impressions, changeless [in himself], he is bound by latent impressions. // 27

4.s:
layodayau tathā'pnoti sa viśrāntaḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
cetanācetanābhyāṃ tu sambandhasya prayojanam || 28 ||
4.d:
लयोदयौ तथाऽप्नोति स विश्रान्तः पुनः पुनः |
चेतनाचेतनाभ्यां तु सम्बन्धस्य प्रयोजनम् || 28 ||
4.m: Thus, having rested, he attains dissolution and emergence again and again. / The purpose of the connection between the conscious and the insentient, // 28

4.s: kathitaṃ nārada mayā kimidānīṃ vadāmi te |
4.d: कथितं नारद मया किमिदानीं वदामि ते |
4.m: has been declared by me, O Nārada. What shall I now tell you?"

4.s:
iti śrīpāñcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ pradhānasargākhyānaṃ nāma
tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ || 3 ||
4.d:
इति श्रीपाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहितायां प्रधानसर्गाख्यानं नाम
तृतीयः पटलः || 3 ||
4.m: Thus, in the venerable Pāñcarātra, in the Jayākhyasaṃhitā, the third chapter, named 'The Account of the Creation of Pradhāna.' // 3

5.s: atha śuddhasargabrahmatattvākhyānaṃ nāma caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ
5.d: अथ शुद्धसर्गब्रह्मतत्त्वाख्यानं नाम चतुर्थः पटलः
5.m: Now begins the fourth chapter, named 'The Account of Pure Creation and the Reality of Brahman.'

5.s: nāradaḥ-
5.d: नारदः-

5.s:
śuddhasargamahaṃ deva vettumicchāmi tattvataḥ |
sargadvayasya caivāsya yaḥ paratvena vartate || 1 ||
5.d:
शुद्धसर्गमहं देव वेत्तुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः |
सर्गद्वयस्य चैवास्य यः परत्वेन वर्तते || 1 ||
5.m: "O God, I wish to know according to reality the pure creation, / and He who exists as transcendent to these two creations." // 1

5.s: (vāsudevātparabrahmaṇastadananyasyācyutāderāvirbhāvaḥ)
5.d: (वासुदेवात्परब्रह्मणस्तदनन्यस्याच्युतादेराविर्भावः)
5.m: (The manifestation of Acyuta and others, non-different from Vāsudeva the supreme Brahman)

5.s: śrībhagavān-
5.d: श्रीभगवान्-

5.s:
yatsarvavyāpakaṃ devaṃ paramaṃ brahma śāśvatam |
citsāmānyaṃ jagatyasminparamānandalakṣaṇam || 2 ||
5.d:
यत्सर्वव्यापकं देवं परमं ब्रह्म शाश्वतम् |
चित्सामान्यं जगत्यस्मिन्परमानन्दलक्षणम् || 2 ||
5.m: "That God who is all-pervading, the supreme, eternal Brahman, / the universal consciousness in this world, characterized by supreme bliss, // 2

5.s:
vāsudevādi(da?)bhinnaṃ tu vahnyarkenduśataprabham |
sa vāsudevo bhagavāṃstaddharmā parameśvaraḥ || 3 ||
5.d:
वासुदेवादि(द?)भिन्नं तु वह्न्यर्केन्दुशतप्रभम् |
स वासुदेवो भगवांस्तद्धर्मा परमेश्वरः || 3 ||
5.m: non-different from Vāsudeva, shining with the splendor of hundreds of fires, suns, and moons— / that Lord is Vāsudeva, the Supreme Lord who possesses those attributes. // 3

5.s:
p. 28) svādīptaṃ kṣobhayitvā tu vidyudvatsyena tejasā |
prakāśarūpī bhagavānacyutaścā(taṃ cā ?)sṛjaddvija || 4 ||
5.d:
प्. 28) स्वादीप्तं क्षोभयित्वा तु विद्युद्वत्स्येन तेजसा |
प्रकाशरूपी भगवानच्युतश्चा(तं चा ?)सृजद्द्विज || 4 ||
5.m: Having agitated his own radiant [essence] by his splendor like lightning, / the Lord, whose form is light, created Acyuta, O twice-born one. // 4

5.s:
so'cyuto'cyutatejāśca svarūpaṃ vitanoti ca |
āśritya vāsudevaṃ ca gharme(rmo) meghadalaṃ yathā || 5 ||
5.d:
सोऽच्युतोऽच्युततेजाश्च स्वरूपं वितनोति च |
आश्रित्य वासुदेवं च घर्मे(र्मो) मेघदलं यथा || 5 ||
5.m: That Acyuta, whose splendor is unfailing, expands his own form, / having taken recourse to Vāsudeva, as heat [takes recourse to] a mass of clouds. // 5

5.s:
kṣobhayitvā svamātmānaṃ satyaṃ bhāsvaravigraham |
utpādayāmāsa tadā samudro budbudaṃ yathā || 6 ||
5.d:
क्षोभयित्वा स्वमात्मानं सत्यं भास्वरविग्रहम् |
उत्पादयामास तदा समुद्रो बुद्बुदं यथा || 6 ||
5.m: Having agitated his own self, he then produced Satya / of radiant form, just as the ocean [produces] a bubble. // 6

5.s:
sa cinmayaprakāśākhya utpādyātmānamātmanā |
puruṣākhyamanantaṃ ca prakāśaprasaraṃ mahat || 7 ||
5.d:
स चिन्मयप्रकाशाख्य उत्पाद्यात्मानमात्मना |
पुरुषाख्यमनन्तं च प्रकाशप्रसरं महत् || 7 ||
5.m: He, whose name is light consisting of consciousness, having produced by himself his self, / [produced] the great expanse of light called Puruṣa, which is endless. // 7

5.s: [puruṣātmanā'virbhūtasya vāsudevasya sarvadevāntaryāmitvam]
5.d: [पुरुषात्मनाऽविर्भूतस्य वासुदेवस्य सर्वदेवान्तर्यामित्वम्]
5.m: [The inner ruler-ship over all gods of Vāsudeva manifested as Puruṣa]

5.s:
sa ca vai sarvadevānāmāśrayaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
antaryāmī sa teṣāṃ vai tārakāṇāṃ yathā'mbaram || 8 ||
5.d:
स च वै सर्वदेवानामाश्रयः परमेश्वरः |
अन्तर्यामी स तेषां वै तारकाणां यथाऽम्बरम् || 8 ||
5.m: And He indeed is the refuge of all gods, the Supreme Lord; / He is their inner ruler, as the sky is of the stars. // 8

5.s:
sendhanaḥ pāvako yadvatsphuliṅganicayaṃ dvija |
anicchataḥ prerayati tadvadeṣa paraḥ prabhuḥ || 9 ||
5.d:
सेन्धनः पावको यद्वत्स्फुलिङ्गनिचयं द्विज |
अनिच्छतः प्रेरयति तद्वदेष परः प्रभुः || 9 ||
5.m: Just as fire possessing fuel impels a mass of sparks, O twice-born one, / without their wishing it, so this supreme Lord [impels]. // 9

5.s:
prāgvāsanānibaddhā ye jīvāstānbandhaśāntaye |
svadeha * * * * * * * tadubhayaṃ punaḥ || 10 ||
5.d:
प्राग्वासनानिबद्धा ये जीवास्तान्बन्धशान्तये |
स्वदेह * * * * * * * तदुभयं पुनः || 10 ||
5.m: Those individual selves who are bound by past latent impressions, for the cessation of their bondage, / [in] one's own body […] both of them again. // 10

5.s: [avatārāṇāṃ tadaṃśatvam]
5.d: [अवताराणां तदंशत्वम्]
5.m: [The status of the incarnations as His parts]

5.s:
ye svidādyāvatārāśca lokatrāṇādhikāriṇaḥ |
sarvānviddhi tadaṃśāṃstānsarve'śāssattvajāstathā || 11 ||
5.d:
ये स्विदाद्यावताराश्च लोकत्राणाधिकारिणः |
सर्वान्विद्धि तदंशांस्तान्सर्वेऽशास्सत्त्वजास्तथा || 11 ||
5.m: Whichever primary incarnations there are who are authorized for the protection of the worlds, / know them all to be His parts; all those parts are born of sattva. // 11

5.s:
[puruṣasatyācyutānāmuttarottarasvarūpādabhinnānāṃ vāsudeve pare
rūpe'vasthitiḥ]
5.d:
[पुरुषसत्याच्युतानामुत्तरोत्तरस्वरूपादभिन्नानां वासुदेवे परे
रूपेऽवस्थितिः]
5.m: [The subsistence in the supreme form, Vāsudeva, of Puruṣa, Satya, and Acyuta, who are non-different from the successively higher forms]

5.s:
sa ca satyādabhinnastu tasmātsatyaṃ tathaiva hi |
dvābhyāmekātmarūpaṃ yattadabhinnamatho'cyutāt || 12 ||
5.d:
स च सत्यादभिन्नस्तु तस्मात्सत्यं तथैव हि |
द्वाभ्यामेकात्मरूपं यत्तदभिन्नमथोऽच्युतात् || 12 ||
5.m: And he [Puruṣa] is non-different from Satya, and from him Satya is likewise [non-different]; / that which is identical with the two is, moreover, non-different from Acyuta. // 12

5.s:
āśritassaṃsthitastābhyāmabhedena sadaiva hi |
pumānsatyo'cyutaścaiva cidrūpaṃ tritayaṃ tu tat || 13 ||
5.d:
आश्रितस्संस्थितस्ताभ्यामभेदेन सदैव हि |
पुमान्सत्योऽच्युतश्चैव चिद्रूपं त्रितयं तु तत् || 13 ||
5.m: Resorting [to one another], they always abide in non-difference from those two; / Puruṣa, Satya, and Acyuta—that triad consists of consciousness, // 13

5.s: śāntasaṃvitsvarūpe ca vāsudeve'vatiṣṭhate |
5.d: शान्तसंवित्स्वरूपे च वासुदेवेऽवतिष्ठते |
5.m: and abides in Vāsudeva, whose nature is tranquil consciousness.

5.s:
[cidrūpasya vāsudevasya tataḥ prādurbhūtasyācyutādirūpatrayasya ca
sanidarśanamabhinnatānirūpaṇam]
5.d:
[चिद्रूपस्य वासुदेवस्य ततः प्रादुर्भूतस्याच्युतादिरूपत्रयस्य च
सनिदर्शनमभिन्नतानिरूपणम्]
5.m: [Demonstration with illustrations of the non-difference of Vāsudeva, consisting of consciousness, and the triad of forms, Acyuta and the others, manifested from Him]

5.s: so'ntaryāmī prakāśātmā cidrūpassa pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 14 ||
5.d: सोऽन्तर्यामी प्रकाशात्मा चिद्रूपस्स प्रतिष्ठितः || 14 ||
5.m: He is the inner ruler, consisting of light, consisting of consciousness, established as such. // 14

5.s:
p. 29) tritaye yastathārūpo'nicchāta uditassadā |
asaṅkalpātmakāssarve prasaranti parasparam || 15 ||
5.d:
प्. 29) त्रितये यस्तथारूपोऽनिच्छात उदितस्सदा |
असङ्कल्पात्मकास्सर्वे प्रसरन्ति परस्परम् || 15 ||
5.m: That which has such a nature in the triad is always arisen without desire; / all, devoid of volition, shine forth mutual [to one another]. // 15

5.s:
dīpavanmuniśārdūla svaparālokadāstu vai |
saṅkalpena vinā tadvadanyo'nyatvena saṃsthitāḥ || 16 ||
5.d:
दीपवन्मुनिशार्दूल स्वपरालोकदास्तु वै |
सङ्कल्पेन विना तद्वदन्योऽन्यत्वेन संस्थिताः || 16 ||
5.m: Like lamps, O tiger among sages, giving light to themselves and others, / they abide in mutual relation without volition in that manner, // 16

5.s:
hṛhṇanti pratibimbatvaṃ darpaṇeṣviva darpaṇam |
atīva dvija nairmalyātsaṅkrāntānāṃ parasparam || 17 ||
5.d:
हृह्णन्ति प्रतिबिम्बत्वं दर्पणेष्विव दर्पणम् |
अतीव द्विज नैर्मल्यात्सङ्क्रान्तानां परस्परम् || 17 ||
5.m: taking on the state of reflection, like a mirror in mirrors. / Because of their extreme purity, O twice-born one, of those passing into one another, // 17

5.s:
pravibhāgo na jāyeta vyomasphaṭikayoryathā |
bhāsādvayasya viprendra tathā teṣāmabhinnatā || 18 ||
5.d:
प्रविभागो न जायेत व्योमस्फटिकयोर्यथा |
भासाद्वयस्य विप्रेन्द्र तथा तेषामभिन्नता || 18 ||
5.m: no distinction can be produced, as between space and crystal; / just as there is non-duality of radiance, O best of Brahmins, so is their non-difference. // 18

5.s:
etadrahasyaṃ paramaṃ mayā te saṃprakāśitam |
sarga ādyo hyananta(nya ?)śca anantasya mahātmanaḥ || 19 ||
5.d:
एतद्रहस्यं परमं मया ते संप्रकाशितम् |
सर्ग आद्यो ह्यनन्त(न्य ?)श्च अनन्तस्य महात्मनः || 19 ||
5.m: This supreme secret has been revealed to you by me; / this is the first, non-different creation of the infinite, great Self." // 19

5.s: nāradaḥ-
5.d: नारदः-

5.s:
mayaitadviditaṃ sarvaṃ sarveśa tvadanugrahāt |
yathā hyasya(si ?) tvamavyakto hyamūrto mūrtatāṃ gataḥ || 20 ||
5.d:
मयैतद्विदितं सर्वं सर्वेश त्वदनुग्रहात् |
यथा ह्यस्य(सि ?) त्वमव्यक्तो ह्यमूर्तो मूर्ततां गतः || 20 ||
5.m: "All this has been understood by me, O Lord of all, through Your grace: / how You, being unmanifest and formless, have attained form. // 20

5.s:
jñātumicchāmi bhagavansvarūpaṃ te yathārthataḥ |
sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ caiva adhyātmani tathā bahiḥ || 21 ||
5.d:
ज्ञातुमिच्छामि भगवन्स्वरूपं ते यथार्थतः |
स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं परं चैव अध्यात्मनि तथा बहिः || 21 ||
5.m: I wish to know Your essential nature, O Blessed Lord, according to reality: / the gross, the subtle, and the supreme, both in the inner self and outside. // 21

5.s:
bhavatprasādasāmarthyādvinaitattritayaṃ katham |
vyajyate viṣayasthānāṃ kuru me'nugrahaṃ vada || 22 ||
5.d:
भवत्प्रसादसामर्थ्याद्विनैतत्त्रितयं कथम् |
व्यज्यते विषयस्थानां कुरु मेऽनुग्रहं वद || 22 ||
5.m: Without the power of Your grace, how can this triad / be manifested to those residing in the realm of sense objects? Bestow Your grace on me; speak!" // 22

5.s:
[sthūla-sūkṣma-parātmanā tredhā'vasthitasya bhagavato rūpasya
nirūpaṇam]
5.d:
[स्थूल-सूक्ष्म-परात्मना त्रेधाऽवस्थितस्य भगवतो रूपस्य
निरूपणम्]
5.m: [Description of the Lord's form abiding threefold as the gross, subtle, and supreme]

5.s: śrībhagavān-
5.d: श्रीभगवान्-

5.s:
sraṣṭā pālayitā cāhaṃ saṃhartā punareva ca |
svakīyayogayuktyā tu sthūlarūpeṇa nārada || 23 ||
5.d:
स्रष्टा पालयिता चाहं संहर्ता पुनरेव च |
स्वकीययोगयुक्त्या तु स्थूलरूपेण नारद || 23 ||
5.m: "I am the creator, the preserver, and also the destroyer, / through the application of my own yoga, in my gross form, O Nārada. // 23

5.s:
sūkṣmeṇa sarvabhūtānāṃ nivasāmi hṛdantare |
karomyanugrahaṃ cāpi bhaktānāṃ bhāvitātmanām || 24 ||
5.d:
सूक्ष्मेण सर्वभूतानां निवसामि हृदन्तरे |
करोम्यनुग्रहं चापि भक्तानां भावितात्मनाम् || 24 ||
5.m: In my subtle [form], I dwell within the heart of all beings, / and I bestow grace upon devotees whose souls are purified. // 24

5.s:
pareṇānandarūpeṇa vyāpakenāmalena ca |
vyāsayāmyakhilaṃ vipra raseneva tarūttamam || 25 ||
5.d:
परेणानन्दरूपेण व्यापकेनामलेन च |
व्यासयाम्यखिलं विप्र रसेनेव तरूत्तमम् || 25 ||
5.m: In my supreme [form], consisting of bliss, all-pervading, and stainless, / I pervade everything, O Brahmin, like sap [pervades] a noble tree // 25

5.s: mūle siktaṃ śikhāśākhāpatrapuṣpaphalānvitam |
5.d: मूले सिक्तं शिखाशाखापत्रपुष्पफलान्वितम् |
5.m: watered at the root, endowed with crest, branches, leaves, flowers, and fruits." // 26ab

5.s: nāradaḥ-
5.d: नारदः-

5.s: satyaṃ tvayā jagatsṛṣṭaṃ vidhṛtaṃ ca tvayā vibho || 26 ||
5.d: सत्यं त्वया जगत्सृष्टं विधृतं च त्वया विभो || 26 ||
5.m: "Truly the world was created by You, and is sustained by You, O All-Pervading One; // 26cd

5.s:
kālarūpī tvamevānte satyaṃ saṃhārakṛtsmṛtaḥ |
pātālādau ca ye lokāstvannābheśca samutthitāḥ || 27 ||
5.d:
कालरूपी त्वमेवान्ते सत्यं संहारकृत्स्मृतः |
पातालादौ च ये लोकास्त्वन्नाभेश्च समुत्थिताः || 27 ||
5.m: You alone, in the form of time, are known in the end as truly the agent of destruction. / And the worlds in Pātāla and elsewhere that have arisen from Your navel—" // 27

5.s:
p. 30) dharmasaṃsthāpanaṃ caiva punareva tvayā kṛtam |
saṃhṛtāśca tvayā daityāḥ śrutaṃ ca viditaṃ mayā || 28 ||
5.d:
प्. 30) धर्मसंस्थापनं चैव पुनरेव त्वया कृतम् |
संहृताश्च त्वया दैत्याः श्रुतं च विदितं मया || 28 ||
5.m: And the establishment of dharma has also been performed again by You, / and the Daityas have been destroyed by You: this I have heard and known. // 28

5.s:
yathā yena prakāreṇa tvameva prakaroṣi ca |
tadvai veditumicchāmi tvatsakāśātsuvistaram || 29 ||
5.d:
यथा येन प्रकारेण त्वमेव प्रकरोषि च |
तद्वै वेदितुमिच्छामि त्वत्सकाशात्सुविस्तरम् || 29 ||
5.m: In what manner and by what method You Yourself do this, / that indeed I wish to know from You in full detail." // 29

5.s:
[sakalaniṣkalātmanā dvidhā bhinnāyā mantrarūpāyā
mūrterbandhatadviparyayahetutvopapādanam]
5.d:
[सकलनिष्कलात्मना द्विधा भिन्नाया मन्त्ररूपाया
मूर्तेर्बन्धतद्विपर्ययहेतुत्वोपपादनम्]
5.m: [Demonstration that the Mantra-Form, Divided into Qualified and Unqualified Aspects, Is the Cause of Bondage and Its Reverse]

5.s: śrībhagavān
5.d: श्रीभगवान्

5.s:
yogavīryeṇa viprenda mantrarūpā purātanī |
niṣkalā sakalā caiva bhogamokṣapradā śubhā || 30 ||
5.d:
योगवीर्येण विप्रेन्द मन्त्ररूपा पुरातनी |
निष्कला सकला चैव भोगमोक्षप्रदा शुभा || 30 ||
5.m: "By the power of yoga, O best of Brahmins, the ancient mantra-form, / both unqualified and qualified, bestows enjoyment and liberation, being auspicious; // 30

5.s:
kṛtā mayā ca lokānāṃ samyagālokadā śubhā |
mantrotpattikrameṇaiva sthitā śāntatarātmanā || 31 ||
5.d:
कृता मया च लोकानां सम्यगालोकदा शुभा |
मन्त्रोत्पत्तिक्रमेणैव स्थिता शान्ततरात्मना || 31 ||
5.m: it was made auspicious by Me, granting true illumination to the worlds, / and it abides in an exceedingly peaceful nature through the sequence of mantra-manifestation. // 31

5.s:
tamomayābhyāṃ mūrttābhyāṃ doṣābhyāṃ nāśanāya vai |
saivāvatiṣṭhate loke prakṛtirviśvapālinī || 32 ||
5.d:
तमोमयाभ्यां मूर्त्ताभ्यां दोषाभ्यां नाशनाय वै |
सैवावतिष्ठते लोके प्रकृतिर्विश्वपालिनी || 32 ||
5.m: Indeed, for the destruction of the two defects embodied in darkness, / that very Prakṛti, protector of the universe, abides in the world. // 32

5.s:
yā karotyevamādīni karmāṇyasminbhavodare |
bhaktānāṃ mokṣayatyāśu kṛtvā bandhaparikṣayam || 33 ||
5.d:
या करोत्येवमादीनि कर्माण्यस्मिन्भवोदरे |
भक्तानां मोक्षयत्याशु कृत्वा बन्धपरिक्षयम् || 33 ||
5.m: She who performs such actions in this womb of existence, / swiftly liberates devotees by bringing about the destruction of their bondage." // 33

5.s: nāradaḥ-
5.d: नारदः-

5.s:
niśśeṣeṇa ca tadyogaṃ tanmantraṃ vīryameva ca |
ādiśasva jagatkartu(rta)ryadi sānugraho'si me || 34 ||
5.d:
निश्शेषेण च तद्योगं तन्मन्त्रं वीर्यमेव च |
आदिशस्व जगत्कर्तु(र्त)र्यदि सानुग्रहोऽसि मे || 34 ||
5.m: "Teach fully that yoga, that mantra, and that very power, / O Creator of the Universe, if You are gracious toward me." // 34

5.s: [mantratadvīryādiparijñānasya brahmajñānamūlatvakathanam]
5.d: [मन्त्रतद्वीर्यादिपरिज्ञानस्य ब्रह्मज्ञानमूलत्वकथनम्]
5.m: [Statement that the Thorough Knowledge of Mantras, Their Power, etc., Is Rooted in Knowledge of Brahman]

5.s: śrībhagavān-
5.d: श्रीभगवान्-

5.s: brahmapūrvamidaṃ sarvaṃ yattvayā codito hyaham || 35 ||
5.d: ब्रह्मपूर्वमिदं सर्वं यत्त्वया चोदितो ह्यहम् || 35 ||
5.m: "All this about which I have been asked by you has Brahman as its source, // 35ab

5.s: yadvinā na pravartante yāni saṅkīrtitāni te |
5.d: यद्विना न प्रवर्तन्ते यानि सङ्कीर्तितानि ते |
5.m: without which those things you have enumerated do not operate." // 35cd

5.s: nāradaḥ-
5.d: नारदः-

5.s: kiṃ tadbrahma vijānīyāṃ yena yogeśvareśvara || 36 ||
5.d: किं तद्ब्रह्म विजानीयां येन योगेश्वरेश्वर || 36 ||
5.m: "What is that Brahman which I should know, by which, O Lord of the lords of yoga, // 36

5.s:
vibhavo mantrapūrvaśca mantropakaraṇaṃ tathā |
pravartante vibho kṣipraṃ bhaktānāṃ bhaktavatsala || 37 ||
5.d:
विभवो मन्त्रपूर्वश्च मन्त्रोपकरणं तथा |
प्रवर्तन्ते विभो क्षिप्रं भक्तानां भक्तवत्सल || 37 ||
5.m: manifestation preceded by mantras and the apparatus of mantras / quickly operate for devotees, O All-Pervading One, O Lover of Devotees?" // 37

5.s: śrībhagavān-
5.d: श्रीभगवान्-

5.s:
jñānena tadabhinnena parijñātena nārada |
jāyate brahmasaṃsaktistasmājjñānaṃ samabhyaset || 38 ||
5.d:
ज्ञानेन तदभिन्नेन परिज्ञातेन नारद |
जायते ब्रह्मसंसक्तिस्तस्माज्ज्ञानं समभ्यसेत् || 38 ||
5.m: "Through knowledge not distinct from It, when fully realized, O Nārada, / attachment to Brahman arises; therefore, one should practice knowledge." // 38

5.s: nāradaḥ-
5.d: नारदः-

5.s:
brahmasiddhipradaṃ jñānaṃ brūhi tallakṣaṇaṃ prabho |
yajjñātvā na bhavejjanma maraṇaṃ bhavabandhanam || 39 ||
5.d:
ब्रह्मसिद्धिप्रदं ज्ञानं ब्रूहि तल्लक्षणं प्रभो |
यज्ज्ञात्वा न भवेज्जन्म मरणं भवबन्धनम् || 39 ||
5.m: "Tell me the characteristic of that knowledge which bestows the attainment of Brahman, O Lord, / knowing which there is no birth, death, [or] bondage of existence." // 39

5.s: p. 31) śrībhagavān-
5.d: प्. 31) श्रीभगवान्-

5.s: [jñānasya dvaividhyam, tayoḥ kriyākhyena sattākhyasya niṣpattiḥ]
5.d: [ज्ञानस्य द्वैविध्यम्, तयोः क्रियाख्येन सत्ताख्यस्य निष्पत्तिः]
5.m: [The Twofold Nature of Knowledge, and the Realization of the Existential Kind Through the Active Kind]

5.s:
jñānaṃ tu dvividhaṃ viddhi sattākhyaṃ ca kriyātmakam |
sattākhyasya kriyākhyena abhyastena bhaveddhṛtiḥ || 40 ||
5.d:
ज्ञानं तु द्विविधं विद्धि सत्ताख्यं च क्रियात्मकम् |
सत्ताख्यस्य क्रियाख्येन अभ्यस्तेन भवेद्धृतिः || 40 ||
5.m: "Know that knowledge is twofold: called existential and consisting of action. / Steadfastness in the existential [knowledge] is attained through practicing that called active." // 40

5.s: nāradaḥ-
5.d: नारदः-

5.s:
jñānaṃ kriyātmakaṃ tāvadvada kīdṛgvidhaṃ prabho |
yenābhyastena sattākhyaṃ jñāsyāmi brahmasiddhidam || 41 ||
5.d:
ज्ञानं क्रियात्मकं तावद्वद कीदृग्विधं प्रभो |
येनाभ्यस्तेन सत्ताख्यं ज्ञास्यामि ब्रह्मसिद्धिदम् || 41 ||
5.m: "First, tell me what kind the knowledge consisting of action is, O Lord, / through practicing which I will know the existential [knowledge] that grants the attainment of Brahman." // 41

5.s: [kriyātmakasya yamaniyamabhedena dvaividhyam]
5.d: [क्रियात्मकस्य यमनियमभेदेन द्वैविध्यम्]
5.m: [The Twofold Nature of the Active Kind, Divided into Restraint and Observance]

5.s: śrībhagavān-
5.d: श्रीभगवान्-

5.s:
dvividhaṃ ca kriyājñānaṃ pūrvaṃ niyamalakṣaṇam |
yamākhyaṃ paramaṃ caiva tacca svābhāvikaṃ smṛtam || 42 ||
5.d:
द्विविधं च क्रियाज्ञानं पूर्वं नियमलक्षणम् |
यमाख्यं परमं चैव तच्च स्वाभाविकं स्मृतम् || 42 ||
5.m: "Active knowledge is twofold: first, characterized by observance (niyama), / and the supreme one called restraint (yama); and that is taught to be natural. // 42

5.s: nirvartya niyamākhyaṃ tadyamayuktaṃ ca siddhidam |
5.d: निर्वर्त्य नियमाख्यं तद्यमयुक्तं च सिद्धिदम् |
5.m: Having accomplished that called observance, joined with restraint, it grants accomplishment." // 43ab

5.s: nāradaḥ-
5.d: नारदः-

5.s: etayorlakṣaṇaṃ brūhi yadāyattaṃ paraṃ padam || 43 ||
5.d: एतयोर्लक्षणं ब्रूहि यदायत्तं परं पदम् || 43 ||
5.m: "Tell me the definition of these two, upon which the supreme state depends, // 43cd

5.s: vistareṇa jagannātha bhavābdhipatitasya me |
5.d: विस्तरेण जगन्नाथ भवाब्धिपतितस्य मे |
5.m: in detail, O Lord of the World, for me who have fallen into the ocean of worldly existence." // 44ab

5.s: [yamaniyamanirūpaṇam]
5.d: [यमनियमनिरूपणम्]

5.s: śrībhagavān-
5.d: श्रीभगवान्-

5.s: śucirijyā tapaścaiva svādhyāyaśrutipūrvakaḥ || 44 ||
5.d: शुचिरिज्या तपश्चैव स्वाध्यायश्रुतिपूर्वकः || 44 ||
5.m: "Purity, worship, and ascetic practice preceded by study and hearing [of scripture], // 44cd

5.s:
akrūratā'niṣṭhuratā kṣamā caivānapāyinī |
satyaṃ bhūtahitaṃ caiva yadabādhā pareṣvapi || 45 ||
5.d:
अक्रूरताऽनिष्ठुरता क्षमा चैवानपायिनी |
सत्यं भूतहितं चैव यदबाधा परेष्वपि || 45 ||
5.m: absence of cruelty, absence of harshness, and unfailing patience, / truthfulness, welfare of living beings, and harmlessness even toward enemies, // 45

5.s:
parasvāderahiṃsā ca cetaso damanaṃ mahat |
indriyābhyavahāryāṇāṃ bhogānāmapi cāspṛhā || 46 ||
5.d:
परस्वादेरहिंसा च चेतसो दमनं महत् |
इन्द्रियाभ्यवहार्याणां भोगानामपि चास्पृहा || 46 ||
5.m: non-injury to others' property and the like, great self-control of the mind, / and lack of desire for objects of enjoyment experienced by the senses, // 46

5.s:
āsane śayane mārge asaktiścāpi bhojane |
hṛdgataṃ na tyajeddhyānamānandaphaladaṃ ca yat || 47 ||
5.d:
आसने शयने मार्गे असक्तिश्चापि भोजने |
हृद्गतं न त्यजेद्ध्यानमानन्दफलदं च यत् || 47 ||
5.m: detachment in sitting, in lying down, upon the path, and in eating; / one should not abandon meditation residing in the heart, which yields the fruit of bliss; // 47

5.s:
ātmaśaktyā pradānaṃ ca satyaṃ vākyamaniṣṭhuram |
amitreṣu ca mitreṣu samā buddhissadaiva hi || 48 ||
5.d:
आत्मशक्त्या प्रदानं च सत्यं वाक्यमनिष्ठुरम् |
अमित्रेषु च मित्रेषु समा बुद्धिस्सदैव हि || 48 ||
5.m: giving according to one's capacity, truthful and unharsh speech, / and an even mind always toward foes and friends, // 48

5.s:
ārjavatvamakauṭilyaṃ kāruṇyaṃ sarvajantuṣu |
etadaṅgānvito yo yo yamo yamaniyāmakaḥ || 49 ||
5.d:
आर्जवत्वमकौटिल्यं कारुण्यं सर्वजन्तुषु |
एतदङ्गान्वितो यो यो यमो यमनियामकः || 49 ||
5.m: straightforwardness, absence of crookedness, compassion toward all creatures: / endowed with these components, whatever yama [is practiced] controls Yamarāja. // 49

5.s:
[kriyākhyātsattākhyaniṣpatterbrahmābhinnajñānodayaḥ, tena
brahmopasampattiḥ]
5.d:
[क्रियाख्यात्सत्ताख्यनिष्पत्तेर्ब्रह्माभिन्नज्ञानोदयः, तेन
ब्रह्मोपसम्पत्तिः]
5.m: [The Rise of Knowledge Undivided from Brahman Through the Realization of the Existential from the Active, and Union with Brahman Through It]

5.s:
evaṃ kriyākhyātsattākhyaṃ jñānaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
p. 32) brahmaṇyabhinnaṃ sattākhyāt jñānājjñānaṃ tato bhavet || 50 ||
5.d:
एवं क्रियाख्यात्सत्ताख्यं ज्ञानं प्राप्नोति मानवः |
प्. 32) ब्रह्मण्यभिन्नं सत्ताख्यात् ज्ञानाज्ज्ञानं ततो भवेत् || 50 ||
5.m: Thus, from the active [knowledge] a person attains existential knowledge; / from existential knowledge, knowledge undivided from Brahman then arises; // 50

5.s: brahmābhinnāttato jñānādbrahma saṃyujyate param |
5.d: ब्रह्माभिन्नात्ततो ज्ञानाद्ब्रह्म संयुज्यते परम् |
5.m: then, through knowledge undivided from Brahman, one is united with supreme Brahman. // 51ab

5.s: [brahmasamāpatterapunarbhavalakṣaṇamokṣarūpatā]
5.d: [ब्रह्मसमापत्तेरपुनर्भवलक्षणमोक्षरूपता]
5.m: [The Nature of Liberation Characterized as the Attainment of Brahman Consisting in Non-Rebirth]

5.s: anādivāsanāyukto yo jīva iti kathyate || 51 ||
5.d: अनादिवासनायुक्तो यो जीव इति कथ्यते || 51 ||
5.m: Endowed with beginningless latent impressions, that which is called the individual self: // 51cd

5.s: tasya brahmasamāpattiryā'punarbhavatā ca sā |
5.d: तस्य ब्रह्मसमापत्तिर्याऽपुनर्भवता च सा |
5.m: its attainment of Brahman is indeed freedom from rebirth. // 52ab

5.s: [brahmābhinnatvaprakāropapādanam]
5.d: [ब्रह्माभिन्नत्वप्रकारोपपादनम्]
5.m: [Demonstration of the Manner of Undividedness from Brahman]

5.s: yatsamyagbrahmavettṛtvaṃ manāgyā caiva bhinnatā || 52 ||
5.d: यत्सम्यग्ब्रह्मवेत्तृत्वं मनाग्या चैव भिन्नता || 52 ||
5.m: That which is complete knowledge of Brahman, and whatever slight difference [remains], // 52cd

5.s: īṣadbrahmasamāpattistadabhinnaṃ tu vai smṛtam |
5.d: ईषद्ब्रह्मसमापत्तिस्तदभिन्नं तु वै स्मृतम् |
5.m: is a partial attainment of Brahman; but [otherwise] it is remembered as undivided from It. // 53ab

5.s: [avidyāyogādātmano devādibhedaḥ]
5.d: [अविद्यायोगादात्मनो देवादिभेदः]
5.m: [The Distinction of the Self into Gods and the Like Through Connection with Ignorance]

5.s: jñānaṃ tvanekabhedairyattattvatāmeti cātmanaḥ || 53 ||
5.d: ज्ञानं त्वनेकभेदैर्यत्तत्त्वतामेति चात्मनः || 53 ||
5.m: Knowledge, through various divisions, assumes the reality of the self // 53cd

5.s: gauṇa(ṇe ?)vidyāmaye tattve samyagvidyāmayasya ca |
5.d: गौण(णे ?)विद्यामये तत्त्वे सम्यग्विद्यामयस्य च |
5.m: in the subordinate principle consisting of ignorance, as well as of that consisting of complete knowledge." // 54ab

5.s: nāradaḥ-
5.d: नारदः-

5.s: kā guṇākhyā hyavidyā ca yatra jñānamayaḥ prabhuḥ || 54 ||
5.d: का गुणाख्या ह्यविद्या च यत्र ज्ञानमयः प्रभुः || 54 ||
5.m: "What is that ignorance called the attributes (guṇas) where the Lord, consisting of knowledge, // 54cd

5.s: tvayoktaṃ yattu (tattva ?)tāmeti bhedairnānāvidhairvibho |
5.d: त्वयोक्तं यत्तु (तत्त्व ?)तामेति भेदैर्नानाविधैर्विभो |
5.m: assumes real form, as spoken by You, through various divisions, O All-Pervading One?" // 55ab

5.s: [avidyāsvarūpanirūpaṇam]
5.d: [अविद्यास्वरूपनिरूपणम्]
5.m: [Exposition of the Nature of Ignorance]

5.s: śrībhagavān-
5.d: श्रीभगवान्-

5.s: guṇatrayasya yatsāmyaṃ sā'vidyā'nekarūpiṇī || 55 ||
5.d: गुणत्रयस्य यत्साम्यं साऽविद्याऽनेकरूपिणी || 55 ||
5.m: "The equilibrium of the triad of attributes is that multiform ignorance, // 55cd

5.s: rāgādīnāṃ ca doṣāṇāmutpattisthānameva ca |
5.d: रागादीनां च दोषाणामुत्पत्तिस्थानमेव च |
5.m: and the very birthplace of defects such as passion." // 56ab

5.s: nāradaḥ-
5.d: नारदः-

5.s: brahmaprāptau tu yassamyagupāyaḥ kathitaḥ purā || 56 ||
5.d: ब्रह्मप्राप्तौ तु यस्सम्यगुपायः कथितः पुरा || 56 ||
5.m: "The means that was fully explained before for attaining Brahman, // 56cd

5.s: sa ca kiṃlakṣaṇo brūhi yaścātmeti tvayoditaḥ |
5.d: स च किंलक्षणो ब्रूहि यश्चात्मेति त्वयोदितः |
5.m: and what its characteristic is, tell [me]; as well as that which was spoken of by you as the self." // 57ab

5.s: [jīvātmanornirūpaṇam]
5.d: [जीवात्मनोर्निरूपणम्]

5.s: śrībhagavān-
5.d: श्रीभगवान्-

5.s: yattatsthitaṃ ca cidrūpaṃ svasaṃvedyādyanirgatam || 57 ||
5.d: यत्तत्स्थितं च चिद्रूपं स्वसंवेद्याद्यनिर्गतम् || 57 ||
5.m: "That which exists as consciousness, not departed from self-awareness and the rest, // 57cd

5.s: rañjitaṃ guṇarāgeṇa sa ātmā kathito dvija |
5.d: रञ्जितं गुणरागेण स आत्मा कथितो द्विज |
5.m: colored by attachment to the attributes—that is declared to be the self, O twice-born."

5.s: nāradaḥ-
5.d: नारदः-

5.s: jñānamātmasvarūpaṃ ca māyā tadrañjikā tu vai || 58 ||
5.d: ज्ञानमात्मस्वरूपं च माया तद्रञ्जिका तु वै || 58 ||
5.m: "Knowledge is the essential nature of the self, and māyā indeed colors it. // 58cd

5.s:
ācakṣva bhagavanbrahma prāgva(gya ?)tsaṃcoditaṃ mayā |
tanme na viditaṃ samyagyadarthaṃ kriyate kriyā || 59 ||
5.d:
आचक्ष्व भगवन्ब्रह्म प्राग्व(ग्य ?)त्संचोदितं मया |
तन्मे न विदितं सम्यग्यदर्थं क्रियते क्रिया || 59 ||
5.m: Explain Brahman, O Blessed Lord, as was requested by me earlier; / that is not fully known to me, for the sake of which ritual action is performed, // 59

5.s: p. 33) yatprāpya na punarjanma bhave'sminprāpyate budhaiḥ |
5.d: प्. 33) यत्प्राप्य न पुनर्जन्म भवेऽस्मिन्प्राप्यते बुधैः |
5.m: having attained which, rebirth in this worldly existence is not experienced by the wise." // 60ab

5.s: [parabrahmanirūpaṇam]
5.d: [परब्रह्मनिरूपणम्]

5.s: śrībhagavān-
5.d: श्रीभगवान्-

5.s: ānandalakṣaṇaṃ brahma sarvaheyavivarjitam || 60 ||
5.d: आनन्दलक्षणं ब्रह्म सर्वहेयविवर्जितम् || 60 ||
5.m: "Brahman has bliss as its characteristic, and is devoid of all that is to be abandoned; // 60cd

5.s:
svasaṃvedyamanaupamyaṃ parā kāṣṭhā parā gatiḥ |
sarvakriyāvinirmuktaṃ sarveṣāmāśrayaṃ prabhuḥ || 61 ||
5.d:
स्वसंवेद्यमनौपम्यं परा काष्ठा परा गतिः |
सर्वक्रियाविनिर्मुक्तं सर्वेषामाश्रयं प्रभुः || 61 ||
5.m: it is self-aware, incomparable, the ultimate limit, the supreme goal, / freed from all action, the refuge of all, the Sovereign Lord. // 61

5.s:
cintāmaṇau yathā sarvaṃ mūrtaṃ saṅgi vyavasthitam |
tathā sarvaṃ tu sarvatra vidyate sarvagasya ca || 62 ||
5.d:
चिन्तामणौ यथा सर्वं मूर्तं सङ्गि व्यवस्थितम् |
तथा सर्वं तु सर्वत्र विद्यते सर्वगस्य च || 62 ||
5.m: Just as everything possessing form is situated in contact within the wish-fulfilling jewel, / so indeed everything exists everywhere for the All-Pervading One. // 62

5.s:
